footnotes.zh: 以斯拉记、尼希米记和以斯帖记，是旧约神选民历史的末三卷书，与神被掳的选民有关(代下三六17～21)。以斯拉记论到神的百姓从被掳归回(参但以理书、哈该书、撒迦利亚书和玛拉基书)，到耶路撒冷重建圣殿；尼希米记论到圣城的修复、重建。以斯帖记给我们一个范例，说出无所不在、无所不能的神，如何成为隐藏的神，秘密保守并照顾祂被掳的选民。 以斯拉记所载以色列人从被掳中的两次归回，应验了神借耶利米所说的应许—被掳仅仅为时七十年(耶二五11～12，二九10，代下三六21～22，但九2)。第一次归回是在所罗巴伯的君王领导下(一～六)，他是大卫王室的后裔，由古列派为犹大省长(五14，参8注1)。第二次归回是在以斯拉的祭司领导下(七～十)。 以色列人从被掳中归回耶路撒冷，有四个极重要的点：(一)恢复神呼召以色列人的定旨，使他们按祂的律法成为祂的见证；(见出二十1注1；)(二)恢复以色列人在耶路撒冷独一立场上的一；(申十二5，11～14；)(三)恢复以色列人对神所应许之美地的享受；(四)使神得以实现祂的意愿，就是借着以色列人有分于并享受美地，在撒但所篡窃的地上建造神的殿，并建立祂的国，为要完成祂永远的经纶。前述一切要点，预表今天召会生活的恢复，就是召会从被掳到大巴比伦(启十七1～6)得着恢复，回到神所选择独一的立场，就是一的立场。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以斯拉記、尼希米記和以斯帖記，是舊約神選民歷史的末三卷書，與神被擄的選民有關。（代下三六17～21。）以斯拉記論到神的百姓從被擄歸回，（參但以理書、哈該書、撒迦利亞書和瑪拉基書，）到耶路撒冷重建聖殿；尼希米記論到聖城的修復、重建。以斯帖記給我們一個範例，說出無所不在、無所不能的神，如何成為隱藏的神，祕密保守並照顧祂被擄的選民。ˍ以斯拉記所載以色列人從被擄中的兩次歸回，應驗了神藉耶利米所說的應許—被擄僅僅為時七十年。（耶二五11～12，二九10，代下三六21～22，但九2。）第一次歸回是在所羅巴伯的君王領導下，（一～六，）他是大衛王室的後裔，由古列派為猶大省長。（五14，參8註1。）第二次歸回是在以斯拉的祭司領導下。（七～十。）ˍ以色列人從被擄中歸回耶路撒冷，有四個極重要的點：(一)恢復神呼召以色列人的定旨，使他們按祂的律法成為祂的見證；（見出二十1註1；）(二)恢復以色列人在耶路撒冷獨一立場上的一；（申十二5，11～14；）(三)恢復以色列人對神所應許之美地的享受；(四)使神得以實現祂的意願，就是藉著以色列人有分於並享受美地，在撒但所篡竊的地上建造神的殿，並建立祂的國，為要完成祂永遠的經綸。前述一切要點，豫表今天召會生活的恢復，就是召會從被擄到大巴比倫（啟十七1～6）得著恢復，回到神所選擇獨一的立場，就是一的立場。
footnotes.en: 1:1 1 Now Ezra, Nehemiah, and Esther, the last three books of the history of God's chosen people in the Old Testament, are related to God's chosen people in their captivity (2 Chron. 36:17-21). Ezra concerns the return of God's people from their captivity (cf. Daniel, Haggai, Zechariah, and Malachi) to Jerusalem to rebuild the temple, and Nehemiah concerns the repair, the rebuilding, of the city. Esther presents to us a pattern of how the omnipresent and omnipotent God becomes the hiding God who secretly preserves and cares for His chosen people in their captivity. The book of Ezra provides a record of the two returns of the children of Israel from their captivity, which fulfilled God's promise, spoken through Jeremiah, that the captivity would last only seventy years (Jer. 25:11-12; 29:10; 2 Chron. 36:21-22; Dan. 9:2). The first return was under the kingly leadership of Zerubbabel (chs. 1—6), a descendant of the royal family of David who was appointed to be the governor of Judah by Cyrus (Ezra 5:14; cf. note Ezra 1:8 1 ). The second return was under the priestly leadership of Ezra (chs. 7—10). The return of Israel to Jerusalem from their captivity was crucial in four points: 1) it recovered the purpose of God's calling Israel to make them His testimony according to His law (see note Exo. 20:1 1 ); 2) it recovered the oneness of Israel on the unique ground of Jerusalem (Deut. 12:5, 11-14); 3) it recovered Israel's enjoyment of the good land promised by God; and 4) it allowed God to fulfill His intention of having His house built and His kingdom established on the Satan-usurped earth in order to carry out His eternal economy through Israel's participation in and enjoyment of the good land. All the foregoing crucial points typify today's recovery of the church life, which is a recovery of the church out of captivity in the great Babylon (Rev. 17:1-6) back to the unique ground of God's choice, the ground of oneness.

footnotes.zh: 在被掳到巴比伦七十年期满时，全能、主宰的神隐密的行动，公开的激动古列王释放以色列被掳的人，回到他们自己的地，建造神的殿(1～4)。激动古列的灵，以及犹大、便雅悯、利未等支派首领的灵(5)，乃是隐藏的神所作的(见斯一1注1一段)，为着祂重建耶路撒冷圣殿的行动。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在被擄到巴比倫七十年期滿時，全能、主宰的神隱密的行動，公開的激動古列王釋放以色列被擄的人，回到他們自己的地，建造神的殿。（1～4。）激動古列的靈，以及猶大、便雅憫、利未等支派首領的靈，（5，）乃是隱藏的神所作的，（見斯一1註1一段，）為著祂重建耶路撒冷聖殿的行動。
footnotes.en: 1:1 2 stirred At the expiration of the seventy years of the captivity in Babylon, the omnipotent, sovereign God moved in a hidden way to stir up King Cyrus openly to release the Israelite captives to go back to their own land to build up God's temple (vv. 1-4). The stirring up of the spirit of Cyrus and the spirits of the leaders of the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Levi (v. 5) was a work of the hiding God (see note Esth. 1:1 1 , par. 1) for His move to rebuild His house in Jerusalem.

footnotes.zh: 古列不但发出诏令，命令以色列被掳的人回到耶路撒冷，在那里重建神的殿(2～4)，并且自己在这事上合作(7～11)，所以他称为神的牧人，成就神所喜悦的；(赛四四28；)他也称为神的受膏者，为神的定旨效力(赛四五1～4，13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 古列不但發出詔令，命令以色列被擄的人回到耶路撒冷，在那裏重建神的殿，（2～4，）並且自己在這事上合作，（7～11，）所以他稱為神的牧人，成就神所喜悅的；（賽四四28；）他也稱為神的受膏者，為神的定旨效力。（賽四五1～4，13。）
footnotes.en: 1:1 3 Cyrus Because Cyrus not only issued the decree ordering the captives of Israel to go back to Jerusalem and rebuild the house of God there (vv. 2-4) but also cooperated in this matter (vv. 7-11), he is called God's shepherd, one who would fulfill God's desire (Isa. 44:28), and God's anointed, one who would serve God's purpose (Isa. 45:1-4, 13).

refs.text_en: And I will bring upon that land all My words which I have spoken against it, everything written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.

footnotes.zh: 以色列人从被掳中得恢复，其专一的目的是为着重建殿宇，作神在地上祂选民中间的家，并为着重建神在地上的国，以完成神永远的经纶。照样，主在今时代召会的恢复，其专一的目的是为着众圣徒在他们所在地聚在一起，在许多城市里同被建造成为神的家(弗二22与注，启一11与注)。借着这样的家，神要得着祂的国，以完成祂的经纶。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列人從被擄中得恢復，其專一的目的是為著重建殿宇，作神在地上祂選民中間的家，並為著重建神在地上的國，以完成神永遠的經綸。照樣，主在今時代召會的恢復，其專一的目的是為著眾聖徒在他們所在地聚在一起，在許多城市裏同被建造成為神的家。（弗二22與註，啟一11與註。）藉著這樣的家，神要得著祂的國，以完成祂的經綸。
footnotes.en: 1:2 1 house The particular intention of the recovery of Israel from their captivity was to rebuild the temple as God's house on the earth among His elect and to re-establish the kingdom of God on the earth for the accomplishing of God's eternal economy. Likewise, the particular intention of the Lord's recovery of the church in this age is to have all the saints come together in their localities to be built up together as the house of God in many cities (Eph. 2:22 and notes; Rev. 1:11 and note Rev. 1:11 1 ). Through such a house God will have His kingdom for the carrying out of His economy.

footnotes.zh: 神殿的金银器皿，预表对基督在祂的救赎(银)里和祂神圣的性情(金)里各面不同的经历。这些经历乃是供应基督作神子民食物的凭借。器皿从巴比伦归回耶路撒冷，预表基督的丰富归回召会真正的一的独一立场，使召会的恢复得着充实。见赛二二24注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神殿的金銀器皿，豫表對基督在祂的救贖（銀）裏和祂神聖的性情（金）裏各面不同的經歷。這些經歷乃是供應基督作神子民食物的憑藉。器皿從巴比倫歸回耶路撒冷，豫表基督的豐富歸回召會真正的一的獨一立場，使召會的恢復得著充實。見賽二二24註2。
footnotes.en: 1:7 1 vessels The gold and silver vessels of the house of God typify the experiences of the various aspects of Christ in His redemption (silver) and in His divine nature (gold). These experiences are the means to serve Christ as food to God's people. The return of the vessels from Babylon to Jerusalem typifies the return of Christ's riches to the unique ground of the genuine oneness of the church to enrich the recovery of the church. See note Isa. 22:24 2 .

refs.text_gb: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及所剩下的群众，都迁徙去了。
refs.text_big5: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及所剩下的群眾，都遷徙去了。
refs.text_en: And the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who deserted to the king of Babylon and the rest of the multitude, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard carried away into exile.

refs.text_gb: 凡脱离刀剑的，迦勒底王都迁徙到巴比伦去，作他和他子孙的奴仆，直到波斯国掌权。
refs.text_big5: 凡脫離刀劍的，迦勒底王都遷徙到巴比倫去，作他和他子孫的奴僕，直到波斯國掌權。
refs.text_en: And those who escaped from the sword he carried away to Babylon, and they became servants to him and to his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

refs.text_gb: 于是百姓出去，取了树枝来，各人在自己的房顶上，或院内，或神殿的院内，或水门的宽阔处，或以法莲门的宽阔处搭棚。
refs.text_big5: 於是百姓出去，取了樹枝來，各人在自己的房頂上，或院內，或神殿的院內，或水門的寬闊處，或以法蓮門的寬闊處搭棚。
refs.text_en: So the people went out and brought them, and all made booths for themselves on their roofs and in their courts and in the courts of the house of God and in the open area before the Water Gate and in the open area before the Gate of Ephraim.

refs.text_gb: 被掳归回的全会众就搭棚，住在棚里。从嫩的儿子约书亚的日子，直到那日，以色列人没有这样行过；于是众人大大喜乐。
refs.text_big5: 被擄歸回的全會眾就搭棚，住在棚裏。從嫩的兒子約書亞的日子，直到那日，以色列人沒有這樣行過；於是眾人大大喜樂。
refs.text_en: And all the assembly of those who returned from the captivity made booths and dwelt in the booths, for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so; and there was very great rejoicing.

refs.text_gb: 所有前来攻击耶路撒冷的列国中余剩的人，必年年上来敬拜大君王万军之耶和华，并守住棚节。
refs.text_big5: 所有前來攻擊耶路撒冷的列國中餘剩的人，必年年上來敬拜大君王萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節。
refs.text_en: And everyone left from all the nations that went forth against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Jehovah of hosts, and to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.

refs.text_gb: 七月十五日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可作，要向耶和华守节七日。
refs.text_big5: 七月十五日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可作，要向耶和華守節七日。
refs.text_en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no work of labor, and you shall hold a feast to Jehovah seven days.

refs.text_gb: 又要将公牛犊十三只，公绵羊两只，一岁的公羊羔十四只，都要没有残疾的，献为燔祭，给耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 又要將公牛犢十三隻，公綿羊兩隻，一歲的公羊羔十四隻，都要沒有殘疾的，獻為燔祭，給耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah: thirteen bulls of the herd, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

refs.text_gb: 要用调油的细面作同献的素祭；为那十三只公牛，每只要献一伊法的十分之三；为那两只公羊，每只要献一伊法的十分之二；
refs.text_big5: 要用調油的細麵作同獻的素祭；為那十三隻公牛，每隻要獻一伊法的十分之三；為那兩隻公羊，每隻要獻一伊法的十分之二；
refs.text_en: And their meal offering of fine flour mingled with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah for each ram of the two rams,

refs.text_gb: 为那十四只羊羔，每只要献一伊法的十分之一。
refs.text_big5: 為那十四隻羊羔，每隻要獻一伊法的十分之一。
refs.text_en: And one-tenth of an ephah for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;

refs.text_gb: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这些是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭，并同献的奠祭以外。
refs.text_big5: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這些是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭，並同獻的奠祭以外。
refs.text_en: And one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

refs.text_gb: 第二日要献公牛犊十二只，公绵羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
refs.text_big5: 第二日要獻公牛犢十二隻，公綿羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
refs.text_en: And on the second day: twelve bulls of the herd, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

refs.text_big5: 第八日你們當有嚴肅會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可作；
refs.text_en: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly; you shall do no work of labor,

refs.text_gb: 只要将公牛一只，公羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只，献为燔祭，给耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭；
refs.text_big5: 只要將公牛一隻，公羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻，獻為燔祭，給耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭；
refs.text_en: But you shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

verses.text_gb: 其后献常献的燔祭，并在月[Cra]朔与耶和华所[Crb]定一切分别为圣的节期献祭，又向耶和华献各人的甘心祭。
verses.text_big5: 其後獻常獻的燔祭，並在月[Cra]朔與耶和華所[Crb]定一切分別為聖的節期獻祭，又向耶和華獻各人的甘心祭。
verses.text_en: And afterward they offered the continual burnt offering and the offerings of the new moons and of all the appointed feasts of Jehovah that were sanctified and of everyone who offered willingly a freewill offering to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 其后献常献的燔祭，并在月朔与耶和华所定一切分别为圣的节期献祭，又向耶和华献各人的甘心祭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 其後獻常獻的燔祭，並在月朔與耶和華所定一切分別為聖的節期獻祭，又向耶和華獻各人的甘心祭。

refs.text_gb: 每月朔，你们要将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只，献给耶和华为燔祭。
refs.text_big5: 每月朔，你們要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻，獻給耶和華為燔祭。
refs.text_en: And at the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to Jehovah: two bulls of the herd and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

refs.text_gb: 为每只公牛，要献调油的细面一伊法的十分之三为素祭；为那只公羊，也要献调油的细面一伊法的十分之二为素祭；
refs.text_big5: 為每隻公牛，要獻調油的細麵一伊法的十分之三為素祭；為那隻公羊，也要獻調油的細麵一伊法的十分之二為素祭；
refs.text_en: And three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for each bull; and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;

refs.text_gb: 为每只羊羔，要献调油的细面一伊法的十分之一为素祭；这些都是燔祭，是献给耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 為每隻羊羔，要獻調油的細麵一伊法的十分之一為素祭；這些都是燔祭，是獻給耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭。
refs.text_en: And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering for each lamb for a burnt offering, a satisfying fragrance, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 与这同献的奠祭，为一只公牛要奠酒半欣，为一只公羊要奠酒一欣的三分之一，为一只羊羔也要奠酒一欣的四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
refs.text_big5: 與這同獻的奠祭，為一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，為一隻公羊要奠酒一欣的三分之一，為一隻羊羔也要奠酒一欣的四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
refs.text_en: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and a third of a hin for the ram, and a fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.

refs.text_gb: 又要将一只公山羊献给耶和华为赎罪祭，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。
refs.text_big5: 又要將一隻公山羊獻給耶和華為贖罪祭，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
refs.text_en: Also one male goat for a sin offering to Jehovah shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

refs.text_gb: 这些祭要在你们所定的节期献给耶和华，都在所许的愿并甘心所献的以外，作为你们的燔祭、素祭、奠祭、和平安祭。
refs.text_big5: 這些祭要在你們所定的節期獻給耶和華，都在所許的願並甘心所獻的以外，作為你們的燔祭、素祭、奠祭、和平安祭。
refs.text_en: These you shall offer to Jehovah in your appointed feasts, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings and for your meal offerings and for your drink offerings and for your peace offerings.

verses.text_gb: 从七月初一日起，他们就向耶和华献燔祭；但耶和华殿的根[Cra]基尚未立定。

verses.text_en: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer up burnt offerings to Jehovah; however the foundation of the temple of Jehovah had not yet been laid.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从七月初一日起，他们就向耶和华献燔祭；但耶和华殿的根基尚未立定。

refs.text_gb: 他们彼此唱和，赞美称谢耶和华说，祂本为善，祂向以色列人永施慈爱。他们赞美耶和华的时候，众民大声呼喊，因耶和华殿的根基立定了。
refs.text_big5: 他們彼此唱和，讚美稱謝耶和華說，祂本為善，祂向以色列人永施慈愛。他們讚美耶和華的時候，眾民大聲呼喊，因耶和華殿的根基立定了。
refs.text_en: And they sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Jehovah, saying, For He is good, for His lovingkindness is forever upon Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised Jehovah, because the foundation of the house of Jehovah was laid.

verses.text_gb: 他们又将银子给石匠、木匠，把粮[Cra]食、饮料、油给西顿人和推罗人，使他们将香[Crb]柏树从利巴嫩运到海里，浮海运到约帕，是照波斯王古[Crc]列所允准的。
verses.text_big5: 他們又將銀子給石匠、木匠，把糧[Cra]食、飲料、油給西頓人和推羅人，使他們將香[Crb]柏樹從利巴嫩運到海裏，浮海運到約帕，是照波斯王古[Crc]列所允准的。
verses.text_en: They also gave money to the stone hewers and to the carpenters, and food and drink and oil to the Sidonians and to the Tyrians, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea at Joppa according to the authorization granted them by Cyrus the king of Persia.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们又将银子给石匠、木匠，把粮食、饮料、油给西顿人和推罗人，使他们将香柏树从利巴嫩运到海里，浮海运到约帕，是照波斯王古列所允准的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們又將銀子給石匠、木匠，把糧食、飲料、油給西頓人和推羅人，使他們將香柏樹從利巴嫩運到海裏，浮海運到約帕，是照波斯王古列所允准的。

refs.text_gb: 希律恼怒推罗和西顿的人；他们就同心合意地来到他那里，托王的内侍臣伯拉斯都说情，向王求和，因为他们那一带地方，是从王的地土得粮。
refs.text_big5: 希律惱怒推羅和西頓的人；他們就同心合意的來到他那裏，託王的內侍臣伯拉斯都說情，向王求和，因為他們那一帶地方，是從王的地土得糧。
refs.text_en: Now he was furious with the Tyrians and Sidonians. And they came to him with one accord; and having persuaded Blastus, the king's chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their country was fed from the king's country.

refs.text_gb: 推罗王希兰差遣使者来见大卫，并且将香柏木和木匠、石匠送来，给大卫建造宫殿。
refs.text_big5: 推羅王希蘭差遣使者來見大衛，並且將香柏木和木匠、石匠送來，給大衛建造宮殿。
refs.text_en: And Hiram the king of Tyre sent messengers to David, as well as cedar timbers and carpenters and masons; and they built David a house.

refs.text_gb: 所以求你吩咐人从利巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木，我的仆人必与你的仆人一同作工，我必照你所说定的，把你仆人的工价给你；因为你知道，在我们中间没有人像西顿人那样善于砍伐树木。
refs.text_big5: 所以求你吩咐人從利巴嫩為我砍伐香柏木，我的僕人必與你的僕人一同作工，我必照你所說定的，把你僕人的工價給你；因為你知道，在我們中間沒有人像西頓人那樣善於砍伐樹木。
refs.text_en: Now therefore command that they cut for me cedars from Lebanon. And my servants will be with your servants, and I will give you payment for your servants, according to whatever you say; for you know that among us there is no one who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.

refs.text_gb: 波斯王古列如此说，耶和华天上的神已将地上万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷为祂建造殿宇。
refs.text_big5: 波斯王古列如此說，耶和華天上的神已將地上萬國賜給我，又囑咐我在猶大的耶路撒冷為祂建造殿宇。
refs.text_en: Thus says Cyrus the king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth has Jehovah the God of heaven given to me; and He has charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

refs.text_gb: 你们中间凡作祂子民的，可以上犹大的耶路撒冷，建造在耶路撒冷之耶和华以色列神的殿；（祂是神；）愿这人的神与他同在。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間凡作祂子民的，可以上猶大的耶路撒冷，建造在耶路撒冷之耶和華以色列神的殿；（祂是神；）願這人的神與他同在。
refs.text_en: Whoever there is among you of all His people, may his God be with him; and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and let him build the house of Jehovah the God of Israel-He is God-who is in Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 古列王元年，古列王降旨论到在耶路撒冷神的殿，要建造这殿为献祭之处，建立殿的根基；殿高六十肘，宽六十肘，

refs.text_en: In the first year of King Cyrus, King Cyrus made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem: Let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices; and let its foundations be raised, its height being sixty cubits, and its width sixty cubits,

verses.text_gb: 众人到了耶路撒冷神殿的地方，第二年二月，撒拉铁的儿子所[Cra]罗巴伯，约萨达的儿子耶书亚，和他们其余的弟兄，就是祭司和利未人，并一切被掳归回耶路撒冷的人，都开工建造；他们派利未人，从二[Crb]十岁以上的，督理建造耶和华殿的工作。
verses.text_big5: 眾人到了耶路撒冷神殿的地方，第二年二月，撒拉鐵的兒子所[Cra]羅巴伯，約薩達的兒子耶書亞，和他們其餘的弟兄，就是祭司和利未人，並一切被擄歸回耶路撒冷的人，都開工建造；他們派利未人，從二[Crb]十歲以上的，督理建造耶和華殿的工作。
verses.text_en: Now in the second year after they came to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak and the rest of their brothers, the priests and the Levites, and all those who came out of captivity to Jerusalem began by appointing the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have oversight over the work of the house of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 众人到了耶路撒冷神殿的地方，第二年二月，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，约萨达的儿子耶书亚，和他们其余的弟兄，就是祭司和利未人，并一切被掳归回耶路撒冷的人，都开工建造；他们派利未人，从二十岁以上的，督理建造耶和华殿的工作。

refs.text_gb: 但所罗巴伯、耶书亚、和其余以色列的宗族首领对他们说，我们为我们的神建殿，与你们无干，我们自己为耶和华以色列的神协力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。
refs.text_big5: 但所羅巴伯、耶書亞、和其餘以色列的宗族首領對他們說，我們為我們的神建殿，與你們無干，我們自己為耶和華以色列的神協力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。
refs.text_en: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the rest of the heads of fathers' houses of Israel said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Jehovah the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.

refs.text_gb: 以上是利未的子孙，按他们的宗族，作宗族的首领，照人名的数目，逐一数点，从二十岁以上，都作耶和华殿事奉之工。
refs.text_big5: 以上是利未的子孫，按他們的宗族，作宗族的首領，照人名的數目，逐一數點，從二十歲以上，都作耶和華殿事奉之工。
refs.text_en: These were the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, the heads of the fathers' houses of those who had been counted, by the number of names, head by head, who did the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.

verses.text_gb: 于是犹大的子孙，就是耶书亚和他的子孙与弟兄，甲篾和他的子孙，另有利未人希拿达的子孙与弟兄，都起来如同一[Cra]人，督理在神殿作工的人。

verses.text_en: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, as one man, with Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, and with the sons of Henadad and their sons and their brothers the Levites, to have oversight over the workmen in the house of God.

refs.text_en: And when the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered together as one man to Jerusalem.

verses.text_en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of Jehovah, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise Jehovah according to the directions of David the king of Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 匠人立耶和华殿根基的时候，百姓首领所派的祭司穿着礼服吹号，亚萨的子孙利未人敲钹，照以色列王大卫所指定的，都站着赞美耶和华。

refs.text_en: Asaph the chief; and second to him Zechariah; Jeiel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel, with harps and with lyres; and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals;

verses.text_gb: 他们彼此唱和，赞美称谢耶和华说，祂本为善，祂向以色列人永施慈爱。他们赞美耶和华的时候，众民大声呼喊，因耶和华殿的根[Cra]基立定了。

verses.text_en: And they sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Jehovah, saying, For He is good, for His lovingkindness is forever upon Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised Jehovah, because the foundation of the house of Jehovah was laid.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们彼此唱和，赞美称谢耶和华说，祂本为善，祂向以色列人永施慈爱。他们赞美耶和华的时候，众民大声呼喊，因耶和华殿的根基立定了。

refs.text_en: And these are the foundations which Solomon laid to build the house of God. The length in cubits, according to the former standard, was sixty cubits, and it was twenty cubits wide.

refs.text_gb: 那火降下，耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地上，面伏于地敬拜，称谢耶和华说，耶和华本为善，祂的慈爱永远长存。
refs.text_big5: 那火降下，耶和華的榮光在殿上的時候，以色列眾人看見，就在鋪石地上，面伏於地敬拜，稱謝耶和華說，耶和華本為善，祂的慈愛永遠長存。
refs.text_en: And all the children of Israel, seeing the fire coming down and the glory of Jehovah upon the house, bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground and worshipped and thanked Jehovah, saying, For He is good; for His lovingkindness endures forever.

footnotes.zh_big5: 這些人是亞述王從巴比倫和亞述遷來住在撒瑪利亞的。（王下十七24與註，約四9與註。）他們倣效以色列人尋求神並向神獻祭，假裝要幫助重建耶和華的殿，但他們為所羅巴伯、約書亞、和其餘宗族首領所拒絕。（1～3。）
footnotes.en: 4:1 1 adversaries These were people brought from Babylon and Assyria by the king of Assyria to inhabit Samaria (2 Kings 17:24 and note 2 Kings 17:24 1 ; John 4:9 and note John 4:9 1 ). Imitating Israel in seeking God and sacrificing to God, they pretended to help the rebuilding of the house of Jehovah, but they were rejected by Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the rest of the heads of the fathers' houses (vv. 1-3).

refs.text_gb: 参巴拉听见我们建造城墙就发怒，大大恼恨，嗤笑犹大人，
refs.text_big5: 參巴拉聽見我們建造城牆就發怒，大大惱恨，嗤笑猶大人，
refs.text_en: And when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he became angry and was greatly enraged; and he mocked the Jews.

refs.text_gb: 对他弟兄和撒玛利亚的军兵说，这些软弱的犹大人作什么呢？他们要为自己修筑城墙么？要献祭么？要一日完成么？要从土堆里拿出火烧的石头再立墙么？
refs.text_big5: 對他弟兄和撒瑪利亞的軍兵說，這些軟弱的猶大人作甚麼呢？他們要為自己修築城牆麼？要獻祭麼？要一日完成麼？要從土堆裏拿出火燒的石頭再立牆麼？
refs.text_en: And he spoke to his brothers and the army of Samaria and said, What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they restore it for themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the dust heaps, though they are burned?

refs.text_gb: 亚扪人多比雅站在旁边，说，他们所建造的石墙，就是狐狸上去也必踩出洞来。
refs.text_big5: 亞捫人多比雅站在旁邊，說，他們所建造的石牆，就是狐狸上去也必踩出洞來。
refs.text_en: And Tobiah the Ammonite was beside him, and he said, Even their stone wall that they are building, if a fox were to go up on it, he would breach it.

refs.text_gb: 我们的神啊，求你垂听，因为我们被藐视；求你使他们的凌辱归在他们头上，使他们在被掳到之地成为掠物。
refs.text_big5: 我們的神阿，求你垂聽，因為我們被藐視；求你使他們的凌辱歸在他們頭上，使他們在被擄到之地成為掠物。
refs.text_en: Hear, O our God, for we are despised; and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them as spoil in the land of captivity;

refs.text_gb: 不要遮掩他们的罪孽，不要使他们的罪从你面前涂抹，因为他们在建造的人面前惹动你的怒气。
refs.text_big5: 不要遮掩他們的罪孽，不要使他們的罪從你面前塗抹，因為他們在建造的人面前惹動你的怒氣。
refs.text_en: And do not cover their iniquity and do not let their sin be blotted out before You, for they made provocations before the builders.

refs.text_gb: 这样，我们建造城墙，城墙就都连接起来，高至一半，因为百姓用心作工。
refs.text_big5: 這樣，我們建造城牆，城牆就都連接起來，高至一半，因為百姓用心作工。
refs.text_en: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a heart to work.

refs.text_gb: 参巴拉、多比雅、亚拉伯人、亚扪人、亚实突人，听见耶路撒冷城墙修复的工作有进展，破裂的地方开始堵住，就甚发怒。
refs.text_big5: 參巴拉、多比雅、亞拉伯人、亞捫人、亞實突人，聽見耶路撒冷城牆修復的工作有進展，破裂的地方開始堵住，就甚發怒。
refs.text_en: And when Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabians and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites heard that the restoration of the walls of Jerusalem was advancing, that the breaches were beginning to be closed up, they became very angry;

refs.text_gb: 他们同谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，使城内扰乱。
refs.text_big5: 他們同謀要來攻擊耶路撒冷，使城內擾亂。
refs.text_en: And all of them conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem and cause confusion in it.

refs.text_gb: 然而，我们祷告我们的神，又因他们的缘故，设立看守的人，昼夜防备。
refs.text_big5: 然而，我們禱告我們的神，又因他們的緣故，設立看守的人，晝夜防備。
refs.text_en: But we prayed to our God, and because of them we set a watch against them day and night.

refs.text_gb: 犹大人说，灰土尚多，扛抬的人力气已经衰败，所以我们不能建造城墙。
refs.text_big5: 猶大人說，灰土尚多，扛抬的人力氣已經衰敗，所以我們不能建造城牆。
refs.text_en: And Judah said, / The strength of the burden bearers fails, / And the debris is great; / And we are not able / To build the wall.

refs.text_gb: 我们的敌人且说，趁他们还不知道，还看不见，我们进入他们中间杀他们，使工作止住。
refs.text_big5: 我們的敵人且說，趁他們還不知道，還看不見，我們進入他們中間殺他們，使工作止住。
refs.text_en: And our adversaries said, They will not know, nor even see, until we come into their midst and slay them and cause the work to stop.

verses.text_gb: 就前来见所罗巴伯和以色列的宗族首领，对他们说，请让我们与你们一同建造；因为我们寻求你们的神，与你们一样；自从亚[Cra]述王以撒哈顿带我们上这地的日子以来，我们常常向祂献祭。
verses.text_big5: 就前來見所羅巴伯和以色列的宗族首領，對他們說，請讓我們與你們一同建造；因為我們尋求你們的神，與你們一樣；自從亞[Cra]述王以撒哈頓帶我們上這地的日子以來，我們常常向祂獻祭。
verses.text_en: They drew near to Zerubbabel and to the heads of fathers' houses and said to them, Let us build with you; for we seek your God as you do, and we have been sacrificing to Him since the days of Esar-haddon the king of Assyria, who brought us up here.
verses.text_gb_plain: 就前来见所罗巴伯和以色列的宗族首领，对他们说，请让我们与你们一同建造；因为我们寻求你们的神，与你们一样；自从亚述王以撒哈顿带我们上这地的日子以来，我们常常向祂献祭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 就前來見所羅巴伯和以色列的宗族首領，對他們說，請讓我們與你們一同建造；因為我們尋求你們的神，與你們一樣；自從亞述王以撒哈頓帶我們上這地的日子以來，我們常常向祂獻祭。

refs.text_gb: 直到耶和华将以色列人从自己面前赶出，正如祂借祂仆人众申言者所说的。这样，以色列人从本地被迁徙到亚述，直到今日。
refs.text_big5: 直到耶和華將以色列人從自己面前趕出，正如祂藉祂僕人眾申言者所說的。這樣，以色列人從本地被遷徙到亞述，直到今日。
refs.text_en: Until Jehovah removed Israel from His sight, as He had said through all His servants the prophets. And Israel was carried away from their own land to Assyria; as it is unto this day.

refs.text_gb: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马、和西法瓦音把人迁来，安置在撒玛利亚的各城，代替以色列人；他们就得了撒玛利亚为业，住在其中的各城。
refs.text_big5: 亞述王從巴比倫、古他、亞瓦、哈馬、和西法瓦音把人遷來，安置在撒瑪利亞的各城，代替以色列人；他們就得了撒瑪利亞為業，住在其中的各城。
refs.text_en: And the king of Assyria brought from Babylon and from Cuthah and from Avva and from Hamath and from Sepharvaim, and made them dwell in the cities of Samaria in place of the children of Israel; and they took possession of Samaria and dwelt in its cities.

verses.text_gb: 但所罗巴伯、耶书亚、和其余以色列的宗族首领对他们说，我们为我们的神建殿，与你们无[Cra]干，我们自己为耶和华以色列的神协力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。
verses.text_big5: 但所羅巴伯、耶書亞、和其餘以色列的宗族首領對他們說，我們為我們的神建殿，與你們無[Cra]干，我們自己為耶和華以色列的神協力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。
verses.text_en: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the rest of the heads of fathers' houses of Israel said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Jehovah the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但所罗巴伯、耶书亚、和其余以色列的宗族首领对他们说，我们为我们的神建殿，与你们无干，我们自己为耶和华以色列的神协力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但所羅巴伯、耶書亞、和其餘以色列的宗族首領對他們說，我們為我們的神建殿，與你們無干，我們自己為耶和華以色列的神協力建造，是照波斯王古列所吩咐的。

refs.text_gb: 我回答他们说，天上的神必亲自使我们亨通；所以我们作祂仆人的，要起来建造。你们却在耶路撒冷无分、无权、无记念。
refs.text_big5: 我回答他們說，天上的神必親自使我們亨通；所以我們作祂僕人的，要起來建造。你們卻在耶路撒冷無分、無權、無記念。
refs.text_en: And I answered them and said to them, The God of heaven Himself will make us prosper; therefore we His servants will rise up and build. But you have no portion nor right nor memorial in Jerusalem.

verses.text_gb: 那地的民，就在犹大人建造的时候，使他们的手发[Cra]软，扰乱他们；
verses.text_big5: 那地的民，就在猶大人建造的時候，使他們的手發[Cra]軟，擾亂他們；
verses.text_en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah and troubled them in building.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那地的民，就在犹大人建造的时候，使他们的手发软，扰乱他们；
verses.text_big5_plain: 那地的民，就在猶大人建造的時候，使他們的手發軟，擾亂他們；

refs.text_gb: 他们都要使我们惧怕，意思说，他们的手必软弱不能作工，以致工作不能成就。现在，神啊，求你坚固我的手。
refs.text_big5: 他們都要使我們懼怕，意思說，他們的手必軟弱不能作工，以致工作不能成就。現在，神阿，求你堅固我的手。
refs.text_en: For all of them tried to frighten us, thinking, Their hands will be weakened from working, and it will not be done. But now strengthen my hands!

refs.text_gb: 于是首领对王说，求你将这人治死，因他向城里余剩的军兵和众民说这样的话，使他们的手发软；这人不是求这百姓的平安，乃是叫他们受灾祸。
refs.text_big5: 於是首領對王說，求你將這人治死，因他向城裏餘剩的軍兵和眾民說這樣的話，使他們的手發軟；這人不是求這百姓的平安，乃是叫他們受災禍。
refs.text_en: Then the princes said to the king, Now let this man be put to death, because of the way he is weakening the hands of the men of war who are left in this city and the hands of all the people by speaking such words to them; for this man is not seeking the welfare of this people, but their harm.

verses.text_gb: 从波斯王古列在位的日子，直到波斯王大利乌作王的时候，贿买谋士，破坏他们的计划。
verses.text_big5: 從波斯王古列在位的日子，直到波斯王大利烏作王的時候，賄買謀士，破壞他們的計畫。
verses.text_en: And they hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus the king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius the king of Persia.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从波斯王古列在位的日子，直到波斯王大利乌作王的时候，贿买谋士，破坏他们的计划。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從波斯王古列在位的日子，直到波斯王大利烏作王的時候，賄買謀士，破壞他們的計畫。

verses.text_gb: 在亚[Cra]哈随鲁才登基作王的时候，他们写了诉状，控告犹大和耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.text_big5: 在亞[Cra]哈隨魯纔登基作王的時候，他們寫了訴狀，控告猶大和耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.text_en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在亚哈随鲁才登基作王的时候，他们写了诉状，控告犹大和耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在亞哈隨魯纔登基作王的時候，他們寫了訴狀，控告猶大和耶路撒冷的居民。

refs.text_gb: 当亚哈随鲁作王的日子，（这亚哈随鲁从印度直到古实，统管一百二十七省，）
refs.text_big5: 當亞哈隨魯作王的日子，（這亞哈隨魯從印度直到古實，統管一百二十七省，）
refs.text_en: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is the Ahasuerus who reigned from India to Ethiopia over one hundred twenty-seven provinces)

verses.text_gb: 亚[Cra]达薛西在位的日子，比施兰、米特利达、他别、和他们的同僚写奏章给波斯王亚达薛西；奏章是用亚[Crb]兰文字写的，译为亚兰方言。
verses.text_big5: 亞[Cra]達薛西在位的日子，比施蘭、米特利達、他別、和他們的同僚寫奏章給波斯王亞達薛西；奏章是用亞[Crb]蘭文字寫的，譯為亞蘭方言。
verses.text_en: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes the king of Persia; and the script of the letter was written in Aramaic and translated into Aramaic.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚达薛西在位的日子，比施兰、米特利达、他别、和他们的同僚写奏章给波斯王亚达薛西；奏章是用亚兰文字写的，译为亚兰方言。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞達薛西在位的日子，比施蘭、米特利達、他別、和他們的同僚寫奏章給波斯王亞達薛西；奏章是用亞蘭文字寫的，譯為亞蘭方言。

refs.text_gb: 这些事以后，波斯王亚达薛西在位的时候，有个以斯拉，他是西莱雅的儿子，西莱雅是亚撒利雅的儿子，亚撒利雅是希勒家的儿子，
refs.text_big5: 這些事以後，波斯王亞達薛西在位的時候，有個以斯拉，他是西萊雅的兒子，西萊雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是希勒家的兒子，
refs.text_en: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

refs.text_gb: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对军长说，求你用亚兰语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大语和我们说话，免得达到城墙上百姓的耳中。
refs.text_big5: 希勒家的兒子以利亞敬、舍伯那和約亞對軍長說，求你用亞蘭語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大語和我們說話，免得達到城牆上百姓的耳中。
refs.text_en: And Eliakim the son of Hilkiah and Shebnah and Joah said to Rab-shakeh, Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, because we understand it; and do not speak with us in the Jews' language in the hearing of the people who are upon the wall.

refs.text_gb: 迦勒底人用亚兰语对王说，愿王万岁！请将那梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解说明。
refs.text_big5: 迦勒底人用亞蘭語對王說，願王萬歲！請將那夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解說明。
refs.text_en: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic, O king, live forever! Tell the dream to your servants, and we will declare the interpretation.

verses.text_gb: 省[Fn1]长利宏和书记伸帅写了奏章给亚达薛西王，控告耶路撒冷人。
verses.text_big5: 省[Fn1]長利宏和書記伸帥寫了奏章給亞達薛西王，控告耶路撒冷人。
verses.text_en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows
verses.text_gb_plain: 省长利宏和书记伸帅写了奏章给亚达薛西王，控告耶路撒冷人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 省長利宏和書記伸帥寫了奏章給亞達薛西王，控告耶路撒冷人。

footnotes.zh: 从此处至六18的经文系亚兰文，非希伯来文。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從此處至六18的經文係亞蘭文，非希伯來文。
footnotes.en: 4:8 1 Rehum From here through 6:18 the text is in Aramaic, not in Hebrew.

verses.text_gb: 那时省长利宏、书记伸帅、和他们的同僚，审判官、官员、他毗拉人、波斯人、以力人、巴比伦人、书珊人，就是以拦人，
verses.text_big5: 那時省長利宏、書記伸帥、和他們的同僚，審判官、官員、他毘拉人、波斯人、以力人、巴比倫人、書珊人，就是以攔人，
verses.text_en: (Then Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the judges, and the officials, the Tarpelites, the Persians, the men of Erech, the Babylonians, the men of Susa, that is the Elamites,
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时省长利宏、书记伸帅、和他们的同僚，审判官、官员、他毗拉人、波斯人、以力人、巴比伦人、书珊人，就是以拦人，
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時省長利宏、書記伸帥、和他們的同僚，審判官、官員、他毘拉人、波斯人、以力人、巴比倫人、書珊人，就是以攔人，

verses.text_gb: 以及其余各民族，就是尊大的亚斯那巴所迁移、安置在撒[Cra]玛利亚城并大河以西其余地方的人，
verses.text_big5: 以及其餘各民族，就是尊大的亞斯那巴所遷移、安置在撒[Cra]瑪利亞城並大河以西其餘地方的人，
verses.text_en: And the rest of the nations, whom the great and noble Osnappar carried into exile and settled in the city of Samaria and in the rest of the province beyond the River, wrote. And now
verses.text_gb_plain: 以及其余各民族，就是尊大的亚斯那巴所迁移、安置在撒玛利亚城并大河以西其余地方的人，
verses.text_big5_plain: 以及其餘各民族，就是尊大的亞斯那巴所遷移、安置在撒瑪利亞城並大河以西其餘地方的人，

refs.text_gb: 耶稣差遣这十二个出去，吩咐他们说：外邦人的路，你们不要走，撒玛利亚人的城，你们也不要进，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌差遣這十二個出去，吩咐他們說：外邦人的路，你們不要走，撒瑪利亞人的城，你們也不要進，
refs.text_en: These twelve Jesus sent forth, charging them, saying, Do not go into the way of the Gentiles, and do not enter into any city of the Samaritans.

verses.text_gb: 向王所呈的奏章，誊抄如下：河西的臣民致亚达薛西王。
verses.text_big5: 向王所呈的奏章，謄抄如下：河西的臣民致亞達薛西王。
verses.text_en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent to him): To Artaxerxes the king, from your servants the men beyond the River. And now
verses.text_gb_plain: 向王所呈的奏章，誊抄如下：河西的臣民致亚达薛西王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 向王所呈的奏章，謄抄如下：河西的臣民致亞達薛西王。

verses.text_gb: 王该知道，从王那里上来的犹大人，已经到了耶路撒冷我们这里；他们正在重[Cra]建这反叛恶劣的城，即将把城墙筑完，已经修好了根基。
verses.text_big5: 王該知道，從王那裏上來的猶大人，已經到了耶路撒冷我們這裏；他們正在重[Cra]建這反叛惡劣的城，即將把城牆築完，已經修好了根基。
verses.text_en: Let it be known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem; they are rebuilding the rebellious and evil city and are finishing the walls and have repaired the foundations.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王该知道，从王那里上来的犹大人，已经到了耶路撒冷我们这里；他们正在重建这反叛恶劣的城，即将把城墙筑完，已经修好了根基。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王該知道，從王那裏上來的猶大人，已經到了耶路撒冷我們這裏；他們正在重建這反叛惡劣的城，即將把城牆築完，已經修好了根基。

refs.text_gb: 以后，我对他们说，我们所遭的祸患，耶路撒冷怎样荒凉，城门被火焚烧，你们都看见了。来吧，我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得再受凌辱。
refs.text_big5: 以後，我對他們說，我們所遭的禍患，耶路撒冷怎樣荒涼，城門被火焚燒，你們都看見了。來罷，我們重建耶路撒冷的城牆，免得再受凌辱。
refs.text_en: Then I said to them, You see the bad state we are in, that Jerusalem lies in waste and its gates are burned with fire. Come and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem so that we will no longer be a reproach.

refs.text_gb: 以禄月二十五日，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。
refs.text_big5: 以祿月二十五日，城牆修完了，共修了五十二天。
refs.text_en: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth day of the month of Elul, in fifty-two days.

verses.text_gb: 如今王该知道，若是这城重建起来，城墙筑完，他们就不再进贡、交课、纳税，终久必使诸王受亏损。
verses.text_big5: 如今王該知道，若是這城重建起來，城牆築完，他們就不再進貢、交課、納稅，終久必使諸王受虧損。
verses.text_en: Now let it be known to the king that if this city is rebuilt and the walls are finished, they will not pay tribute, taxes, or tolls; and in the end it will cause damage to the kings.
verses.text_gb_plain: 如今王该知道，若是这城重建起来，城墙筑完，他们就不再进贡、交课、纳税，终久必使诸王受亏损。
verses.text_big5_plain: 如今王該知道，若是這城重建起來，城牆築完，他們就不再進貢、交課、納稅，終久必使諸王受虧損。

verses.text_gb: 我们既食[Fn1]王家的盐，不该见王受辱，因此上奏禀告于王。
verses.text_big5: 我們既食[Fn1]王家的鹽，不該見王受辱，因此上奏稟告於王。
verses.text_en: Now because we eat the salt of the palace, and it is not fitting for us to see the king's dishonor, we therefore have sent this letter to inform the king,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们既食王家的盐，不该见王受辱，因此上奏禀告于王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們既食王家的鹽，不該見王受辱，因此上奏稟告於王。

footnotes.zh: 比喻之辞，意，受王供养。
footnotes.zh_big5: 比喻之辭，意，受王供養。
footnotes.en: 4:14 1 we A figurative expression meaning to be supported by the king.

verses.text_gb: 请王考察先王的记录，必可查知这城是悖逆的城，与列王和各省有害；自古以来，常有人在其中行反叛的事，因此这城曾被拆毁。
verses.text_big5: 請王考察先王的記錄，必可查知這城是悖逆的城，與列王和各省有害；自古以來，常有人在其中行反叛的事，因此這城曾被拆毀。
verses.text_en: So that a search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers, and you may find in the book of the records and know that this city is a rebellious city and one that causes damage to kings and provinces and that they have stirred up sedition within it in times past; for which reason this city was laid waste.
verses.text_gb_plain: 请王考察先王的记录，必可查知这城是悖逆的城，与列王和各省有害；自古以来，常有人在其中行反叛的事，因此这城曾被拆毁。
verses.text_big5_plain: 請王考察先王的記錄，必可查知這城是悖逆的城，與列王和各省有害；自古以來，常有人在其中行反叛的事，因此這城曾被拆毀。

verses.text_gb: 我们禀告于王，若是这城重建起来，城墙筑完，河西之地王就无分了。
verses.text_big5: 我們稟告於王，若是這城重建起來，城牆築完，河西之地王就無分了。
verses.text_en: We inform the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls are finished, then you will have no portion beyond the River.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们禀告于王，若是这城重建起来，城墙筑完，河西之地王就无分了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們稟告於王，若是這城重建起來，城牆築完，河西之地王就無分了。

verses.text_gb: 那时王下谕达于省长利宏、书记伸帅、和他们的同僚，就是住撒玛利亚并河西其余地方的人，说，愿你们平安。
verses.text_big5: 那時王下諭達於省長利宏、書記伸帥、和他們的同僚，就是住撒瑪利亞並河西其餘地方的人，說，願你們平安。
verses.text_en: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their companions who dwelt in Samaria and in the rest of the province beyond the River: Greetings. And now
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时王下谕达于省长利宏、书记伸帅、和他们的同僚，就是住撒玛利亚并河西其余地方的人，说，愿你们平安。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時王下諭達於省長利宏、書記伸帥、和他們的同僚，就是住撒瑪利亞並河西其餘地方的人，說，願你們平安。

verses.text_gb: 你们所呈的奏章，译文已经在我面前读过了。
verses.text_big5: 你們所呈的奏章，譯文已經在我面前讀過了。
verses.text_en: The letter which you sent to us has been read before me in translation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们所呈的奏章，译文已经在我面前读过了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們所呈的奏章，譯文已經在我面前讀過了。

verses.text_gb: 我命人考察，得知此城古来果然曾背叛诸王，其中常有悖逆反叛的事。
verses.text_big5: 我命人考察，得知此城古來果然曾背叛諸王，其中常有悖逆反叛的事。
verses.text_en: And a decree has been issued by me, and a search has been made; and it was found that this city in times past has risen against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made in it,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我命人考察，得知此城古来果然曾背叛诸王，其中常有悖逆反叛的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我命人考察，得知此城古來果然曾背叛諸王，其中常有悖逆反叛的事。

verses.text_gb: 从前也有强大的君王治理耶路撒冷，统[Cra]管河西全地，人就给他们进贡、交课、纳税。
verses.text_big5: 從前也有強大的君王治理耶路撒冷，統[Cra]管河西全地，人就給他們進貢、交課、納稅。
verses.text_en: And that there have been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the lands beyond the River; and tribute, taxes and tolls were paid to them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从前也有强大的君王治理耶路撒冷，统管河西全地，人就给他们进贡、交课、纳税。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從前也有強大的君王治理耶路撒冷，統管河西全地，人就給他們進貢、交課、納稅。

refs.text_gb: 所罗门统管诸国，从大河到非利士人之地，直到埃及的边界；所罗门在世的一切日子，这些国都进贡服事他。
refs.text_big5: 所羅門統管諸國，從大河到非利士人之地，直到埃及的邊界；所羅門在世的一切日子，這些國都進貢服事他。
refs.text_en: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines and unto the border of Egypt; they brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

refs.text_gb: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
refs.text_big5: 所羅門統管諸王，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。
refs.text_en: And he was the ruler over all the kings from the River unto the land of the Philistines and unto the border of Egypt.

verses.text_gb: 现在你们要出令叫这些人停工，使这城不得建造，等我降旨。
verses.text_big5: 現在你們要出令叫這些人停工，使這城不得建造，等我降旨。
verses.text_en: Now make a decree to stop these men, so that this city is not rebuilt until a decree is made by me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 现在你们要出令叫这些人停工，使这城不得建造，等我降旨。
verses.text_big5_plain: 現在你們要出令叫這些人停工，使這城不得建造，等我降旨。

verses.text_gb: 你们当谨慎，在这事上不可疏忽；为何容害加重，使王受亏损呢？
verses.text_big5: 你們當謹慎，在這事上不可疏忽；為何容害加重，使王受虧損呢？
verses.text_en: And take care not to be negligent in this. Why should damage grow to the detriment of the kings?
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们当谨慎，在这事上不可疏忽；为何容害加重，使王受亏损呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們當謹慎，在這事上不可疏忽；為何容害加重，使王受虧損呢？

verses.text_gb: 亚达薛西王下谕的誊本，读在利宏和书记伸帅，并他们的同僚面前，他们就急忙往耶路撒冷去见犹大人，用武力强迫他们停工。
verses.text_big5: 亞達薛西王下諭的謄本，讀在利宏和書記伸帥，並他們的同僚面前，他們就急忙往耶路撒冷去見猶大人，用武力強迫他們停工。
verses.text_en: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes's letter was read before Rehum and Shimshai the scribe and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews and stopped them by force and power.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚达薛西王下谕的誊本，读在利宏和书记伸帅，并他们的同僚面前，他们就急忙往耶路撒冷去见犹大人，用武力强迫他们停工。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞達薛西王下諭的謄本，讀在利宏和書記伸帥，並他們的同僚面前，他們就急忙往耶路撒冷去見猶大人，用武力強迫他們停工。

verses.text_gb: 于是，在耶路撒冷神殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大利乌第二年。
verses.text_big5: 於是，在耶路撒冷神殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大利烏第二年。
verses.text_en: So the work of the house of God, which is in Jerusalem, ceased; and it was stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius the king of Persia.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是，在耶路撒冷神殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大利乌第二年。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是，在耶路撒冷神殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大利烏第二年。

verses.text_gb: 那时，申[Fn1]言者哈[Cra]该和易多的孙子撒[Crb]迦利亚，在临到他们之以色列神的名里，向犹大和耶路撒冷的犹大人申言。
verses.text_big5: 那時，申[Fn1]言者哈[Cra]該和易多的孫子撒[Crb]迦利亞，在臨到他們之以色列神的名裏，向猶大和耶路撒冷的猶大人申言。
verses.text_en: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel who was over them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时，申言者哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚，在临到他们之以色列神的名里，向犹大和耶路撒冷的犹大人申言。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時，申言者哈該和易多的孫子撒迦利亞，在臨到他們之以色列神的名裏，向猶大和耶路撒冷的猶大人申言。

footnotes.zh: 重建之工得以继续，是因着申言者哈该和撒迦利亚申言的勉励和帮助(1～2)。在以色列人中间的神治行政里，有三种职分：祭司、君王和申言者。大祭司的职责是将有关神百姓的事带到神面前，等候神借着乌陵和土明即时的说话(出二八30与注)。然后大祭司将神的决断和指示，传给负神行政责任的君王，付诸实行。每当祭司与君王软弱不能胜任，神就兴起申言者为祂说话，以加强并辅助祭司职分与君王职分(撒上三11～21，撒下十二1～25)。见民二七21注1与申十六18注2。 为着神在地上居所的建造，祭司职分与君王职分的职事都是需要的。帐幕是借着大祭司亚伦，和代表神圣权柄的摩西立起的；圣殿是在大祭司和所罗门王指示下建造的；圣殿的重建，是借着约书亚的祭司职分，和犹大省长所罗巴伯(该一1)的权柄完成的。在建造恢复的圣殿时，约书亚和所罗巴伯都有几分软弱灰心；因此，神使用申言者哈该和撒迦利亚为祂说话，加强并勉励约书亚和所罗巴伯(见哈该书和撒迦利亚书)。 在神的经纶中，祭司职分和君王职分要存到永远(启二二3，5)，而在千年国时代和永世里，申言者职分将不再需要(但九24与注4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 重建之工得以繼續，是因著申言者哈該和撒迦利亞申言的勉勵和幫助。（1～2。）在以色列人中間的神治行政裏，有三種職分：祭司、君王和申言者。大祭司的職責是將有關神百姓的事帶到神面前，等候神藉著烏陵和土明即時的說話。（出二八30與註。）然後大祭司將神的決斷和指示，傳給負神行政責任的君王，付諸實行。每當祭司與君王軟弱不能勝任，神就興起申言者為祂說話，以加強並輔助祭司職分與君王職分。（撒上三11～21，撒下十二1～25。）見民二七21註1與申十六18註2。ˍ為著神在地上居所的建造，祭司職分與君王職分的職事都是需要的。帳幕是藉著大祭司亞倫，和代表神聖權柄的摩西立起的；聖殿是在大祭司和所羅門王指示下建造的；聖殿的重建，是藉著約書亞的祭司職分，和猶大省長所羅巴伯（該一1）的權柄完成的。在建造恢復的聖殿時，約書亞和所羅巴伯都有幾分軟弱灰心；因此，神使用申言者哈該和撒迦利亞為祂說話，加強並勉勵約書亞和所羅巴伯。（見哈該書和撒迦利亞書。）ˍ在神的經綸中，祭司職分和君王職分要存到永遠，（啟二二3，5，）而在千年國時代和永世裏，申言者職分將不再需要。（但九24與註4。）
footnotes.en: 5:1 1 prophets The rebuilding work continued through the encouragement and help of the prophesying of the prophets Haggai and Zechariah (vv. 1-2). In God's theocratic administration among the people of Israel, there were three offices: the priests, the kings, and the prophets. The responsibility of the high priest was to bring the matters concerning God's people into God's presence and wait on God for His instant speaking through the Urim and the Thummim (Exo. 28:30 and notes). The high priest then passed on God's decision and instructions to the king, who was responsible in God's administration to carry them out. Whenever the priests and the kings became weak and inadequate, God raised up the prophets to speak for Him in order to strengthen and assist the priesthood and the kingship (1 Sam. 3:11-21; 2 Sam. 12:1-25). See note Num. 27:21 1 and note Deut. 16:18 1 . For the building of God's dwelling place on earth, the ministries of both the priesthood and the kingship are needed. The tabernacle was raised up through Aaron, the high priest, and Moses, representing the divine authority; the temple was built under the high priest and Solomon the king; the rebuilding of the temple was accomplished through the priesthood of Joshua and the authority of Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah (Hag. 1:1). In the building of the recovered temple both Joshua and Zerubbabel became somewhat weak and discouraged. Therefore, God used the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak for Him and to strengthen and encourage Joshua and Zerubbabel (see the books of Haggai and Zechariah). In God's economy the priesthood and the kingship will remain forever (Rev. 22:3, 5), whereas in the age of the millennium and in eternity the prophethood will not be needed (Dan. 9:24 and note Dan. 9:24 4 ).

verses.text_en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build the house of God, which is in Jerusalem; and the prophets of God were with them, helping them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约萨达的儿子耶书亚都起来，动手建造在耶路撒冷神的殿，有神的申言者与他们同在，帮助他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約薩達的兒子耶書亞都起來，動手建造在耶路撒冷神的殿，有神的申言者與他們同在，幫助他們。

refs.text_gb: 毗大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯、示每。所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰、哈拿尼雅，他们的姊妹是示罗密。
refs.text_big5: 毘大雅的兒子是所羅巴伯、示每。所羅巴伯的兒子是米書蘭、哈拿尼雅，他們的姊妹是示羅密。
refs.text_en: And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister;

refs.text_gb: 约萨达的儿子耶书亚和他的弟兄众祭司，并撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯与他的弟兄，都起来建造以色列神的坛，要照神人摩西律法书上所写的，在坛上献燔祭。
refs.text_big5: 約薩達的兒子耶書亞和他的弟兄眾祭司，並撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯與他的弟兄，都起來建造以色列神的壇，要照神人摩西律法書上所寫的，在壇上獻燔祭。
refs.text_en: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up, along with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his brothers, and they built the altar of the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings upon it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

refs.text_gb: 迁徙到巴比伦以后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁，撒拉铁生所罗巴伯，
refs.text_big5: 遷徙到巴比倫以後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵，撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯，
refs.text_en: And after the deportation to Babylon, Jeconiah begot Salathiel, and Salathiel begot Zerubbabel,

refs.text_gb: 约大是约亚拿的儿子，约亚拿是利撒的儿子，利撒是所罗巴伯的儿子，所罗巴伯是撒拉铁的儿子，撒拉铁是尼利的儿子，
refs.text_big5: 約大是約亞拿的兒子，約亞拿是利撒的兒子，利撒是所羅巴伯的兒子，所羅巴伯是撒拉鐵的兒子，撒拉鐵是尼利的兒子，
refs.text_en: The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Salathiel, the son of Neri,

refs.text_gb: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并一切余剩的百姓，都听从耶和华他们神的话，和耶和华他们神所差来申言者哈该的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。
refs.text_big5: 那時，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並一切餘剩的百姓，都聽從耶和華他們神的話，和耶和華他們神所差來申言者哈該的話；百姓也在耶和華面前存敬畏的心。
refs.text_en: And Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of Jehovah their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, as Jehovah their God had sent him; and the people were in fear before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华的差使对百姓说，耶和华说，我与你们同在。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者哈該奉耶和華的差使對百姓說，耶和華說，我與你們同在。
refs.text_en: Then Haggai, Jehovah's messenger, spoke in Jehovah's message to the people, saying, I am with you, declares Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华激动撒拉铁的儿子犹大省长所罗巴伯的灵，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的灵，并一切余剩之百姓的灵；他们就来，在万军之耶和华他们神的殿作工。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華激動撒拉鐵的兒子猶大省長所羅巴伯的靈，和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞的靈，並一切餘剩之百姓的靈；他們就來，在萬軍之耶和華他們神的殿作工。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of Jehovah of hosts their God,

refs.text_gb: 犹大长老因申言者哈该、和易多的孙子撒迦利亚的申言，就建造这殿，凡事亨通。他们照着以色列神的命令和波斯王古列、大利乌、亚达薛西的旨意，建造完毕。
refs.text_big5: 猶大長老因申言者哈該、和易多的孫子撒迦利亞的申言，就建造這殿，凡事亨通。他們照著以色列神的命令和波斯王古列、大利烏、亞達薛西的旨意，建造完畢。
refs.text_en: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and according to the decree of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes the king of Persia.

verses.text_gb: 当时河西的总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚来见他们，这样问说，谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？
verses.text_big5: 當時河西的總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並他們的同僚來見他們，這樣問說，誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？
verses.text_en: At the same time Tattenai the governor beyond the River and Shethar-bozenai and their companions came to them and spoke to them in this way, Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?
verses.text_gb_plain: 当时河西的总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚来见他们，这样问说，谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 當時河西的總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並他們的同僚來見他們，這樣問說，誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？

verses.text_gb: 我们便告诉他们，建造这殿宇的人叫什么名字。
verses.text_big5: 我們便告訴他們，建造這殿宇的人叫甚麼名字。
verses.text_en: Then we told them accordingly what the names of the men were who were constructing this building.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们便告诉他们，建造这殿宇的人叫什么名字。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們便告訴他們，建造這殿宇的人叫甚麼名字。

verses.text_gb: 神的眼[Cra]目看顾犹大的长老，以致那[Fn1]些人没有叫他们停工，直到呈报于大利乌，得着关于这事的回谕。
verses.text_big5: 神的眼[Cra]目看顧猶大的長老，以致那[Fn1]些人沒有叫他們停工，直到呈報於大利烏，得著關於這事的回諭。
verses.text_en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, and they did not stop them, until a report went to Darius; and then an answer was returned by letter concerning it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 神的眼目看顾犹大的长老，以致那些人没有叫他们停工，直到呈报于大利乌，得着关于这事的回谕。
verses.text_big5_plain: 神的眼目看顧猶大的長老，以致那些人沒有叫他們停工，直到呈報於大利烏，得著關於這事的回諭。

footnotes.zh: 那些人，直译，他们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那些人，直譯，他們。

refs.text_gb: 看哪，耶和华的眼目，看顾敬畏祂的人，和仰望祂慈爱的人，
refs.text_big5: 看哪，耶和華的眼目，看顧敬畏祂的人，和仰望祂慈愛的人，
refs.text_en: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon those who fear Him, / Upon those who hope in His lovingkindness,

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人，祂的耳朵听他们的呼求。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人，祂的耳朵聽他們的呼求。
refs.text_en: The eyes of Jehovah are set toward the righteous, / And His ears, toward their cry.

refs.text_gb: 因为主的眼看顾义人，祂的耳垂听他们的祈求；唯有行恶的人，主向他们变脸。”
refs.text_big5: 因為主的眼看顧義人，祂的耳垂聽他們的祈求；惟有行惡的人，主向他們變臉。”
refs.text_en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears incline to their petition; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

verses.text_gb: 河西的总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚，就是在河西的官员，所呈于大利乌王的奏章，誊抄如下；
verses.text_big5: 河西的總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並他們的同僚，就是在河西的官員，所呈於大利烏王的奏章，謄抄如下；
verses.text_en: This is the copy of the letter that Tattenai the governor beyond the River and Shethar-bozenai and his companions the officials, who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king;
verses.text_gb_plain: 河西的总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚，就是在河西的官员，所呈于大利乌王的奏章，誊抄如下；
verses.text_big5_plain: 河西的總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並他們的同僚，就是在河西的官員，所呈於大利烏王的奏章，謄抄如下；

verses.text_gb: 他们呈报于王，报告中写着说，愿大利乌王诸事平安。
verses.text_big5: 他們呈報於王，報告中寫著說，願大利烏王諸事平安。
verses.text_en: They sent a report to him in which was written as follows, To Darius the king, all peace.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们呈报于王，报告中写着说，愿大利乌王诸事平安。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們呈報於王，報告中寫著說，願大利烏王諸事平安。

verses.text_gb: 王该知道，我们往犹大省去，到了至大神的殿，这殿是用大石建造的，梁木插入墙内；这工作进行甚为迅速，并且在他们手下亨通。
verses.text_big5: 王該知道，我們往猶大省去，到了至大神的殿，這殿是用大石建造的，梁木插入牆內；這工作進行甚為迅速，並且在他們手下亨通。
verses.text_en: Let it be known to the king that we went to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with large stones, and timber is being laid in the walls; and this work is being conducted with diligence and prospers in their hands.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王该知道，我们往犹大省去，到了至大神的殿，这殿是用大石建造的，梁木插入墙内；这工作进行甚为迅速，并且在他们手下亨通。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王該知道，我們往猶大省去，到了至大神的殿，這殿是用大石建造的，梁木插入牆內；這工作進行甚為迅速，並且在他們手下亨通。

verses.text_gb: 我们问那些长老说，谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？
verses.text_big5: 我們問那些長老說，誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？
verses.text_en: Then we asked those elders, speaking to them in this way, Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们问那些长老说，谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們問那些長老說，誰降旨讓你們建造這殿，修成這牆呢？

verses.text_gb: 我们又问他们的名字，要记录他们首领的名字，禀告于王。
verses.text_big5: 我們又問他們的名字，要記錄他們首領的名字，稟告於王。
verses.text_en: We also asked them their names in order to inform you, so that we might write down the names of the men who were at their head.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们又问他们的名字，要记录他们首领的名字，禀告于王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們又問他們的名字，要記錄他們首領的名字，稟告於王。

verses.text_gb: 他们这样回答说，我们是天[Cra]地之神的仆人，重建多年前所建造的殿[Crb]，就是以色列的一位大君王建造完成的。
verses.text_big5: 他們這樣回答說，我們是天[Cra]地之神的僕人，重建多年前所建造的殿[Crb]，就是以色列的一位大君王建造完成的。
verses.text_en: And they returned us an answer in this way, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are rebuilding the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们这样回答说，我们是天地之神的仆人，重建多年前所建造的殿，就是以色列的一位大君王建造完成的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們這樣回答說，我們是天地之神的僕人，重建多年前所建造的殿，就是以色列的一位大君王建造完成的。

refs.text_gb: 他们向天上的神献燔祭所需用的公牛犊、公绵羊、绵羊羔，并所用的麦子、盐、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的话，每日供给他们，不得有误；
refs.text_big5: 他們向天上的神獻燔祭所需用的公牛犢、公綿羊、綿羊羔，並所用的麥子、鹽、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的話，每日供給他們，不得有誤；
refs.text_en: And whatever is needed, young bulls and rams and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are in Jerusalem, let it be given to them day by day without fail,

refs.text_gb: 好叫他们献馨香的祭给天上的神，又为王和王众子的性命祷告。
refs.text_big5: 好叫他們獻馨香的祭給天上的神，又為王和王眾子的性命禱告。
refs.text_en: That they may offer incense to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.

refs.text_gb: 你们要称谢天上的神，因祂的慈爱永远长存。
refs.text_big5: 你們要稱謝天上的神，因祂的慈愛永遠長存。
refs.text_en: Give thanks to the God of heaven, / For His lovingkindness is forever.

refs.text_gb: 这奥秘的事，就在夜间异象中，启示给但以理。但以理便颂赞天上的神。
refs.text_big5: 這奧祕的事，就在夜間異象中，啟示給但以理。但以理便頌讚天上的神。
refs.text_en: Then the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 当那列王在位的日子，天上的神必兴起一国，永不败灭，国权也不留归别民，却要打碎灭绝那一切国；这国必存到永远。
refs.text_big5: 當那列王在位的日子，天上的神必興起一國，永不敗滅，國權也不留歸別民，卻要打碎滅絕那一切國；這國必存到永遠。
refs.text_en: And in the days of those kings the God of the heavens will raise up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, and its reign will not be left to another people; it will crush and put an end to all these kingdoms; and it will stand forever.

refs.text_gb: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的人有七千名，其余的都惊恐，将荣耀归与天上的神。
refs.text_big5: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的人有七千名，其餘的都驚恐，將榮耀歸與天上的神。
refs.text_en: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and seven thousand men were killed in the earthquake, and the rest became terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

refs.text_gb: 以色列人出埃及地后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，开工建造耶和华的殿。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人出埃及地後四百八十年，所羅門作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，開工建造耶和華的殿。
refs.text_en: Then in the four hundred eightieth year after the children of Israel had come forth out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of his reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv (this is the second month), Solomon began to build the house of Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 只因我们列祖惹天上的神发怒，神把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼[Cra]布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毁这殿，又将百姓迁徙到巴比伦。
verses.text_big5: 只因我們列祖惹天上的神發怒，神把他們交在迦勒底人巴比倫王尼[Cra]布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毀這殿，又將百姓遷徙到巴比倫。
verses.text_en: But because our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to anger, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away to Babylon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只因我们列祖惹天上的神发怒，神把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毁这殿，又将百姓迁徙到巴比伦。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只因我們列祖惹天上的神發怒，神把他們交在迦勒底人巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毀這殿，又將百姓遷徙到巴比倫。

refs.text_gb: 约雅敬在位的日子，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上到犹大；约雅敬作他的臣仆三年，然后又背叛他。
refs.text_big5: 約雅敬在位的日子，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上到猶大；約雅敬作他的臣僕三年，然後又背叛他。
refs.text_en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years; then he turned and rebelled against him.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华打发迦勒底人、亚兰人、摩押人、和亚扪人，结队攻击约雅敬；祂打发他们攻击毁灭犹大，正如耶和华借祂仆人众申言者所说的话。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華打發迦勒底人、亞蘭人、摩押人、和亞捫人，結隊攻擊約雅敬；祂打發他們攻擊毀滅猶大，正如耶和華藉祂僕人眾申言者所說的話。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah sent against him bands of the Chaldeans and bands of the Syrians and bands of the Moabites and bands of the children of Ammon; and He sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of Jehovah, which He spoke through his servants the prophets.

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆，护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比倫王的臣僕，護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
refs.text_en: In the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month (this was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguard, the servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.text_gb_plain: 不要拦阻神这殿的工作，任凭犹大人的省长和犹大人的长老在原处建造神的这殿。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要攔阻神這殿的工作，任憑猶大人的省長和猶大人的長老在原處建造神的這殿。

verses.text_gb: 我又降旨，论到你们向犹大人的这些长老，为建造神的这殿当怎样行，就是从王的资产，从河西的贡物中，给他们拨出充足的经费，免得工程停顿。
verses.text_big5: 我又降旨，論到你們向猶大人的這些長老，為建造神的這殿當怎樣行，就是從王的資產，從河西的貢物中，給他們撥出充足的經費，免得工程停頓。
verses.text_en: Moreover I make a decree concerning what you are to do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: From the property of the king, even the tribute of the province beyond the River, expenses are to be given in full to these men that the work not cease.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我又降旨，论到你们向犹大人的这些长老，为建造神的这殿当怎样行，就是从王的资产，从河西的贡物中，给他们拨出充足的经费，免得工程停顿。

verses.text_en: And whatever is needed, young bulls and rams and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are in Jerusalem, let it be given to them day by day without fail,

verses.text_en: That they may offer incense to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.
verses.text_gb_plain: 好叫他们献馨香的祭给天上的神，又为王和王众子的性命祷告。
verses.text_big5_plain: 好叫他們獻馨香的祭給天上的神，又為王和王眾子的性命禱告。

refs.text_gb: 我所使你们迁徙到的那城，你们要为那城求平安，为那城祷告耶和华，因为那城得平安，你们也随着得平安。
refs.text_big5: 我所使你們遷徙到的那城，你們要為那城求平安，為那城禱告耶和華，因為那城得平安，你們也隨著得平安。
refs.text_en: And seek the peace of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to Jehovah for it; for in its peace you will have peace.

refs.text_gb: 所以我劝你，第一要为万人祈求、祷告、代求、感谢；
refs.text_big5: 所以我勸你，第一要為萬人祈求、禱告、代求、感謝；
refs.text_en: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings be made on behalf of all men;

refs.text_gb: 为君王和一切有权位的也该如此，使我们可以十分敬虔庄重地过平静安宁的生活。
refs.text_big5: 為君王和一切有權位的也該如此，使我們可以十分敬虔莊重的過平靜安寧的生活。
refs.text_en: On behalf of kings and all who are in high position, that we may lead a quiet and tranquil life in all godliness and gravity.

verses.text_gb: 我再降旨，无论谁更改这命令，必从他房屋中拆出一根梁木，把他举起，钉在其上，并且因这缘故，使他的房屋成为粪堆。
verses.text_big5: 我再降旨，無論誰更改這命令，必從他房屋中拆出一根梁木，把他舉起，釘在其上，並且因這緣故，使他的房屋成為糞堆。
verses.text_en: Also I have made a decree that whoever alters this word, timber shall be pulled out from his house, and he shall be lifted up and impaled on it, and his house shall be made a dunghill on account of this.

verses.text_en: And may the God who has caused His name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who put forth their hand to alter this or to destroy this house of God, which is in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have made a decree; let it be carried out with all diligence.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若有任何王和民伸手更改这命令，拆毁在耶路撒冷神的这殿，愿那使自己的名居住在那里的神将他们灭绝。我大利乌降旨，当彻底迅速的遵行。

refs.text_gb: 你要为我筑土坛，在上面献牛羊为燔祭和平安祭；在我使人记念我名的各地方，我必到你那里赐福给你。
refs.text_big5: 你要為我築土壇，在上面獻牛羊為燔祭和平安祭；在我使人記念我名的各地方，我必到你那裏賜福給你。
refs.text_en: An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and you shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen; in every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.

refs.text_gb: 但耶和华你们的神从你们各支派中，所选择出来立祂名的地方，就是祂的居所，那是你们当寻求的，你们要往那里去，
refs.text_big5: 但耶和華你們的神從你們各支派中，所選擇出來立祂名的地方，就是祂的居所，那是你們當尋求的，你們要往那裏去，
refs.text_en: But to the place which Jehovah your God will choose out of all your tribes to put His name, to His habitation, shall you seek, and there shall you go.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对他说，你在我面前所祷告恳求的，我都应允了；我已将你所建造的这殿分别为圣，把我的名永远立在那里；我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對他說，你在我面前所禱告懇求的，我都應允了；我已將你所建造的這殿分別為聖，把我的名永遠立在那裏；我的眼、我的心也必常在那裏。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to him, I have heard your prayer and your supplication which you have made before Me; I have sanctified this house which you have built by putting My name there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there continually.

verses.text_gb: 于是，河西总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚，就照着大利乌王所降的谕旨，彻底迅速的遵行。
verses.text_big5: 於是，河西總督達乃和示他波斯乃，並他們的同僚，就照著大利烏王所降的諭旨，徹底迅速的遵行。
verses.text_en: Then Tattenai the governor beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their companions, carried out everything with all diligence according to what Darius the king had sent order to do.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是，河西总督达乃和示他波斯乃，并他们的同僚，就照着大利乌王所降的谕旨，彻底迅速的遵行。

verses.text_en: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. refs.text_gb: 那时，申言者哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚，在临到他们之以色列神的名里，向犹大和耶路撒冷的犹大人申言。

refs.text_en: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel who was over them.

footnotes.zh: 以色列人首次从被掳归回(见一1注1)，需要所罗巴伯的君王领导；他是王室后裔，知道如何治理，并且领头建造祭坛和圣殿。此后，领导的需要从王室转到祭司职分，转到大祭司亚伦的后裔以斯拉(1～5)。以斯拉不仅是祭司，也是精通神律法的经学家(6)。以斯拉是这样的人，所以有能力应付这需要。 在所罗巴伯的领导下重建圣殿以后，百姓仍然是任性的，因为他们在构成上已成了巴比伦人。因此，需要以斯拉这样的人，既是事奉神的祭司，又是经学家，学者，精通神的话，精通摩西的律法。以斯拉具有属天神圣构成与文化的总和。他将百姓带回到神的话，使他们被圣言中属天的真理重新教育并重新构成。见尼八1注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列人首次從被擄歸回，（見一1註1，）需要所羅巴伯的君王領導；他是王室後裔，知道如何治理，並且領頭建造祭壇和聖殿。此後，領導的需要從王室轉到祭司職分，轉到大祭司亞倫的後裔以斯拉。（1～5。）以斯拉不僅是祭司，也是精通神律法的經學家。（6。）以斯拉是這樣的人，所以有能力應付這需要。ˍ在所羅巴伯的領導下重建聖殿以後，百姓仍然是任性的，因為他們在構成上已成了巴比倫人。因此，需要以斯拉這樣的人，既是事奉神的祭司，又是經學家，學者，精通神的話，精通摩西的律法。以斯拉具有屬天神聖構成與文化的總和。他將百姓帶回到神的話，使他們被聖言中屬天的真理重新教育並重新構成。見尼八1註1。
footnotes.en: 7:1 1 Ezra The first return of Israel from their captivity (see note Ezra 1:1 1 ) needed the kingly leadership of Zerubbabel, a royal descendant who knew how to govern and who took the lead in building up the altar and the temple. After this, the need shifted from the royal family to the priesthood, to Ezra, a descendant of the high priest Aaron (vv. 1-5). Ezra was not only a priest but also a scribe, a person who was skilled in the law of God (v. 6). As such a one, Ezra had the capacity to meet the need. After the rebuilding of the temple under the leadership of Zerubbabel, the people were still unruly, for they had become Babylonian in their constitution. Therefore, there was the need for an Ezra, one who was both a priest who served God and also a scribe, a scholar, who was skilled in the Word of God, skilled in the law of Moses. Ezra bore the totality of the heavenly and divine constitution and culture. He brought the people back to the Word of God that they might be re-educated and reconstituted with the heavenly truths in the divine Word. See note Neh. 8:1 1 .

refs.text_en: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,

refs.text_gb: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生亚希玛斯，
refs.text_big5: 亞希突生撒督，撒督生亞希瑪斯，
refs.text_en: And Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz,

refs.text_gb: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅，亚撒利雅生约哈难，
refs.text_big5: 亞希瑪斯生亞撒利雅，亞撒利雅生約哈難，
refs.text_en: And Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan,

refs.text_gb: 约哈难生亚撒利雅；（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分；）
refs.text_big5: 約哈難生亞撒利雅；（這亞撒利雅在所羅門於耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的職分；）
refs.text_en: And Johanan begot Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem);

refs.text_gb: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅，亚玛利雅生亚希突，
refs.text_big5: 亞撒利雅生亞瑪利雅，亞瑪利雅生亞希突，
refs.text_en: And Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,

refs.text_gb: 亚希突生撒督，撒督生沙龙，
refs.text_big5: 亞希突生撒督，撒督生沙龍，
refs.text_en: And Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum,

refs.text_gb: 沙龙生希勒家，希勒家生亚撒利雅，
refs.text_big5: 沙龍生希勒家，希勒家生亞撒利雅，
refs.text_en: And Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah,

refs.text_gb: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅，西莱雅生约萨答；
refs.text_big5: 亞撒利雅生西萊雅，西萊雅生約薩答；
refs.text_en: And Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak,

verses.text_gb: 希勒家是沙龙的儿子，沙龙是撒督的儿子，撒督是亚希突的儿子，
verses.text_big5: 希勒家是沙龍的兒子，沙龍是撒督的兒子，撒督是亞希突的兒子，
verses.text_en: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.text_gb_plain: 希勒家是沙龙的儿子，沙龙是撒督的儿子，撒督是亚希突的儿子，
verses.text_big5_plain: 希勒家是沙龍的兒子，沙龍是撒督的兒子，撒督是亞希突的兒子，

verses.text_gb: 亚希突是亚玛利雅的儿子，亚玛利雅是亚撒利雅的儿子，亚撒利雅是米拉约的儿子，
verses.text_big5: 亞希突是亞瑪利雅的兒子，亞瑪利雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是米拉約的兒子，
verses.text_en: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚希突是亚玛利雅的儿子，亚玛利雅是亚撒利雅的儿子，亚撒利雅是米拉约的儿子，
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞希突是亞瑪利雅的兒子，亞瑪利雅是亞撒利雅的兒子，亞撒利雅是米拉約的兒子，

verses.text_gb: 米拉约是西拉希雅的儿子，西拉希雅是乌西的儿子，乌西是布基的儿子，
verses.text_big5: 米拉約是西拉希雅的兒子，西拉希雅是烏西的兒子，烏西是布基的兒子，
verses.text_en: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.text_gb_plain: 米拉约是西拉希雅的儿子，西拉希雅是乌西的儿子，乌西是布基的儿子，
verses.text_big5_plain: 米拉約是西拉希雅的兒子，西拉希雅是烏西的兒子，烏西是布基的兒子，

verses.text_gb: 布基是亚比书的儿子，亚比书是非尼哈的儿子，非尼哈是以利亚撒的儿子，以利亚撒是祭司长亚伦的儿子；
verses.text_big5: 布基是亞比書的兒子，亞比書是非尼哈的兒子，非尼哈是以利亞撒的兒子，以利亞撒是祭司長亞倫的兒子；
verses.text_en: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest;
verses.text_gb_plain: 布基是亚比书的儿子，亚比书是非尼哈的儿子，非尼哈是以利亚撒的儿子，以利亚撒是祭司长亚伦的儿子；
verses.text_big5_plain: 布基是亞比書的兒子，亞比書是非尼哈的兒子，非尼哈是以利亞撒的兒子，以利亞撒是祭司長亞倫的兒子；

verses.text_gb: 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是经[Cra]学家，精通耶和华以色列神所赐摩西的律法。王赐他一切所[Fn1]求的，是因耶[Fn2][Crb]和华他神的手帮助他。
verses.text_big5: 這以斯拉從巴比倫上來，他是經[Cra]學家，精通耶和華以色列神所賜摩西的律法。王賜他一切所[Fn1]求的，是因耶[Fn2][Crb]和華他神的手幫助他。
verses.text_en: This Ezra went up from Babylon, and he was a scribe skilled in the law of Moses, which Jehovah the God of Israel had given; and the king granted him all his request according to the hand of Jehovah his God upon him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是经学家，精通耶和华以色列神所赐摩西的律法。王赐他一切所求的，是因耶和华他神的手帮助他。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這以斯拉從巴比倫上來，他是經學家，精通耶和華以色列神所賜摩西的律法。王賜他一切所求的，是因耶和華他神的手幫助他。

footnotes.zh: 首次从巴比伦归回耶路撒冷是神起的头(一1，5)，第二次归回是以斯拉起的头，他去向王恳求赐他所要的。以斯拉知道首次归回并不完美，也不完全。他知道需要有精通神律法，认识神的心、神的渴望和神的经纶的人，帮助百姓不仅笼统的认识神，更是按照神所说过的话认识神。以斯拉有这样的才能，所以他自愿去向王要求谕旨，准许犹太人归回他们列祖之地。
footnotes.zh_big5: 首次從巴比倫歸回耶路撒冷是神起的頭，（一1，5，）第二次歸回是以斯拉起的頭，他去向王懇求賜他所要的。以斯拉知道首次歸回並不完美，也不完全。他知道需要有精通神律法，認識神的心、神的渴望、和神的經綸的人，幫助百姓不僅籠統的認識神，更是按照神所說過的話認識神。以斯拉有這樣的才能，所以他自願去向王要求諭旨，准許猶太人歸回他們列祖之地。
footnotes.en: 7:6 1 request The first return from Babylon to Jerusalem was initiated by God (Ezra 1:1, 5). The second return was initiated by Ezra, who went to the king and appealed to him to grant his request. Ezra realized that the first return was not perfect, not complete. He realized that there was the need for someone who was skilled in the law of God and who knew God's heart, God's desire, and God's economy, to help the people to know God not merely in a general way but according to what God had spoken. Ezra had such a capacity, so he volunteered to go to the king and to request a decree from the king permitting the Jews to return to the land of their fathers.

footnotes.zh: 本书没有说到神的灵，却多次提到神的手(见串珠b)。当神的灵在里面作工，那是灵；当神的灵在外面作工，那是神的手。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本書沒有說到神的靈，卻多次題到神的手。（見串珠b。）當神的靈在裏面作工，那是靈；當神的靈在外面作工，那是神的手。
footnotes.en: 7:6 2 hand This book does not speak of the Spirit of God, but the hand of God is mentioned a number of times (see reference). When God's Spirit works inwardly, that is the Spirit. When God's Spirit works outwardly, that is God's hand.

refs.text_gb: 祭司以斯拉是经学家，精通耶和华的诫命和祂赐给以色列之律例的话。亚达薛西王颁给他的谕旨，誊抄如下：
refs.text_big5: 祭司以斯拉是經學家，精通耶和華的誡命和祂賜給以色列之律例的話。亞達薛西王頒給他的諭旨，謄抄如下：
refs.text_en: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, a scribe of the words of the commandments of Jehovah and of His statutes for Israel:

refs.text_gb: 诸王之王亚达薛西，达于祭司以斯拉，精通天上神律法的经学家，愿诸事美满。如今
refs.text_big5: 諸王之王亞達薛西，達於祭司以斯拉，精通天上神律法的經學家，願諸事美滿。如今
refs.text_en: Artaxerxes, the king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace. And now

refs.text_gb: 众民如同一人，聚集在水门前的宽阔处，请经学家以斯拉将摩西的律法书带来，这律法是耶和华吩咐以色列人遵守的。
refs.text_big5: 眾民如同一人，聚集在水門前的寬闊處，請經學家以斯拉將摩西的律法書帶來，這律法是耶和華吩咐以色列人遵守的。
refs.text_en: And all the people gathered as one man in the open area that was before the Water Gate. And they told Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Jehovah had commanded to Israel.

refs.text_gb: 经学家以斯拉站在为这事特制的木台上；玛他提雅、示玛、亚奈雅、乌利亚、希勒家、和玛西雅站在他的右边；毗大雅、米沙利、玛基雅、哈顺、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亚、和米书兰站在他的左边。
refs.text_big5: 經學家以斯拉站在為這事特製的木臺上；瑪他提雅、示瑪、亞奈雅、烏利亞、希勒家、和瑪西雅站在他的右邊；毘大雅、米沙利、瑪基雅、哈順、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亞、和米書蘭站在他的左邊。
refs.text_en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a wooden platform that had been made for that purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah and Shema and Anaiah and Uriah and Hilkiah and Maaseiah at his right hand; and at his left hand, Pedaiah and Mishael and Malchijah and Hashum and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

refs.text_gb: 次日，众民宗族的首领、祭司、和利未人，都聚集到经学家以斯拉那里，要深入领略律法书上的话。
refs.text_big5: 次日，眾民宗族的首領、祭司、和利未人，都聚集到經學家以斯拉那裏，要深入領略律法書上的話。
refs.text_en: And on the second day the heads of fathers' houses of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered to Ezra the scribe, that is, in order to gain insight into the words of the law.

refs.text_gb: 这些都是在约撒达的孙子，耶书亚的儿子约雅金的日子，并在省长尼希米和作祭司的经学家以斯拉的日子，有职任的。
refs.text_big5: 這些都是在約撒達的孫子，耶書亞的兒子約雅金的日子，並在省長尼希米和作祭司的經學家以斯拉的日子，有職任的。
refs.text_en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

refs.text_gb: 又有撒迦利亚的弟兄示玛雅、亚萨列、米拉莱、基拉莱、玛艾、拿坦业、犹大、哈拿尼，都拿着神人大卫的乐器；经学家以斯拉走在他们前面。
refs.text_big5: 又有撒迦利亞的弟兄示瑪雅、亞薩列、米拉萊、基拉萊、瑪艾、拿坦業、猶大、哈拿尼，都拿著神人大衛的樂器；經學家以斯拉走在他們前面。
refs.text_en: And his brothers, Shemaiah and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

refs.text_gb: 他就召集了所有的祭司长和民间的经学家，向他们查问，基督当生在何处。
refs.text_big5: 他就召集了所有的祭司長和民間的經學家，向他們查問，基督當生在何處。
refs.text_en: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.

refs.text_gb: 经学家和法利赛人是坐在摩西的位上，
refs.text_big5: 經學家和法利賽人是坐在摩西的位上，
refs.text_en: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees have seated themselves in Moses' seat;

refs.text_gb: 耶稣在殿里施教，说，经学家怎么说，基督是大卫的子孙？
refs.text_big5: 耶穌在殿裏施教，說，經學家怎麼說，基督是大衛的子孫？
refs.text_en: And Jesus, while He was teaching in the temple, answered and said, How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

refs.text_gb: 祂又对他们说，因此，凡经学家作诸天之国门徒的，就像一个作家主的人，从他库里拿出新旧的东西来。
refs.text_big5: 祂又對他們說，因此，凡經學家作諸天之國門徒的，就像一個作家主的人，從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, For this reason every scribe discipled to the kingdom of the heavens is like a householder who brings forth out of his treasure things new and old.

refs.text_gb: 他在正月初一日，从巴比伦动身上来；因他神美善的手帮助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。
refs.text_big5: 他在正月初一日，從巴比倫動身上來；因他神美善的手幫助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。
refs.text_en: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem according to the good hand of his God upon him.

refs.text_gb: 祂又在王和谋士面前，并王一切大能的军长面前施慈爱与我。因耶和华我神的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。
refs.text_big5: 祂又在王和謀士面前，並王一切大能的軍長面前施慈愛與我。因耶和華我神的手幫助我，我就得以堅強，從以色列中招聚首領，與我一同上來。
refs.text_en: And has extended lovingkindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the mighty officers of the king. And I was strengthened according to the hand of Jehovah my God upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel leading men to go up with me.

refs.text_gb: 因我们神美善的手帮助我们，他们在以色列的曾孙，利未的孙子，抹利的后裔中带了一个聪敏的人来，就是示利比，还有他的众子与弟兄，共十八人；
refs.text_big5: 因我們神美善的手幫助我們，他們在以色列的曾孫，利未的孫子，抹利的後裔中帶了一個聰敏的人來，就是示利比，還有他的眾子與弟兄，共十八人；
refs.text_en: And according to the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; namely, Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen men;

refs.text_gb: 我求王拨步兵马兵，帮助我们抵挡路上的仇敌，本以为羞耻；因我们曾对王说，我们神的手必帮助一切寻求祂的，使他们得好处；但祂的能力和忿怒，必攻击一切离弃祂的。
refs.text_big5: 我求王撥步兵馬兵，幫助我們抵擋路上的仇敵，本以為羞恥；因我們曾對王說，我們神的手必幫助一切尋求祂的，使他們得好處；但祂的能力和忿怒，必攻擊一切離棄祂的。
refs.text_en: For I was ashamed to ask for troops and horsemen from the king to help us against the enemy in the way because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is for good upon all those who seek Him, but His power and His wrath is against all those who forsake Him.

refs.text_gb: 正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河边起行，要往耶路撒冷去；我们神的手帮助我们，救我们脱离仇敌和路上埋伏之人的手。
refs.text_big5: 正月十二日，我們從亞哈瓦河邊起行，要往耶路撒冷去；我們神的手幫助我們，救我們脫離仇敵和路上埋伏之人的手。
refs.text_en: Then we set out from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and He delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from people set in ambush on the way.

refs.text_gb: 又赐诏书，通知看守王园林的亚萨，使他给我木料，作属殿营楼之门的横梁，并供城墙和我要住的房屋使用。因我神美善的手帮助我，王就把我所求的赐给我。
refs.text_big5: 又賜詔書，通知看守王園林的亞薩，使他給我木料，作屬殿營樓之門的橫梁，並供城牆和我要住的房屋使用。因我神美善的手幫助我，王就把我所求的賜給我。
refs.text_en: And a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the Park, which belongs to the king, so that he would give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace that belongs to the house and for the wall of the city and for the house that I will be entering. And the king gave these to me according to the good hand of my God, which was upon me.

refs.text_gb: 我告诉他们，我神美善的手怎样帮助我，也把王对我所说的话告诉他们。他们就说，我们起来建造吧；于是他们奋勇作这善工。
refs.text_big5: 我告訴他們，我神美善的手怎樣幫助我，也把王對我所說的話告訴他們。他們就說，我們起來建造罷；於是他們奮勇作這善工。
refs.text_en: And I told them about the hand of my God, which was good upon me, and also about the king's words, which he had spoken to me. And they said, Let us rise up and build; and they strengthened their hands for the good work.

verses.text_gb: 亚[Cra]达薛西王第七年，也有些以[Crb]色列人、祭[Crc]司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的和殿[Crd]役，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.text_big5: 亞[Cra]達薛西王第七年，也有些以[Crb]色列人、祭[Crc]司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的和殿[Crd]役，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.text_en: Some of the children of Israel and some of the priests, and the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers and the temple servants also went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚达薛西王第七年，也有些以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的和殿役，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞達薛西王第七年，也有些以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的和殿役，上耶路撒冷去。

refs.text_big5: 亞達薛西在位的日子，比施蘭、米特利達、他別、和他們的同僚寫奏章給波斯王亞達薛西；奏章是用亞蘭文字寫的，譯為亞蘭方言。

verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你当用这金银，审慎迅速的买公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔，和同献的素祭、奠祭之物，献在耶路撒冷你们神殿的坛上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你當用這金銀，審慎迅速的買公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔，和同獻的素祭、奠祭之物，獻在耶路撒冷你們神殿的壇上。

verses.text_gb: 剩下的金银，你和你的弟兄看着怎样用为妥，就怎样用，总要照着你们神的旨意。
verses.text_big5: 剩下的金銀，你和你的弟兄看著怎樣用為妥，就怎樣用，總要照著你們神的旨意。
verses.text_en: And whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, you may do according to the will of your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 剩下的金银，你和你的弟兄看着怎样用为妥，就怎样用，总要照着你们神的旨意。
verses.text_big5_plain: 剩下的金銀，你和你的弟兄看著怎樣用為妥，就怎樣用，總要照著你們神的旨意。

verses.text_gb: 所交给你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要全部交在耶路撒冷的神面前。
verses.text_big5: 所交給你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要全部交在耶路撒冷的神面前。
verses.text_en: And the vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver in full before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所交给你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要全部交在耶路撒冷的神面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所交給你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要全部交在耶路撒冷的神面前。

verses.text_gb: 你神殿里其余的需用，若要由你支付，你可以从王的宝库里支取。
verses.text_big5: 你神殿裏其餘的需用，若要由你支付，你可以從王的寶庫裏支取。
verses.text_en: And the rest of the needs for the house of your God, which you have occasion to provide, you may provide for it out of the king's treasure house.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你神殿里其余的需用，若要由你支付，你可以从王的宝库里支取。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你神殿裏其餘的需用，若要由你支付，你可以從王的寶庫裏支取。

verses.text_gb: 我亚达薛西王又降旨与河西的一切库官，说，精通天上神律法的经学家祭司以斯拉，无论向你们要什么，你们都要周到迅速的备办，
verses.text_big5: 我亞達薛西王又降旨與河西的一切庫官，說，精通天上神律法的經學家祭司以斯拉，無論向你們要甚麼，你們都要周到迅速的備辦，
verses.text_en: And I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are in the province beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我亚达薛西王又降旨与河西的一切库官，说，精通天上神律法的经学家祭司以斯拉，无论向你们要什么，你们都要周到迅速的备办，
verses.text_big5_plain: 我亞達薛西王又降旨與河西的一切庫官，說，精通天上神律法的經學家祭司以斯拉，無論向你們要甚麼，你們都要周到迅速的備辦，

verses.text_gb: 就是银子直到一百他连得，麦子一百柯珥，酒一百罢特，油一百罢特，盐不计其数，也要给他。
verses.text_big5: 就是銀子直到一百他連得，麥子一百柯珥，酒一百罷特，油一百罷特，鹽不計其數，也要給他。
verses.text_en: Up to one hundred talents of silver and up to one hundred cors of wheat and up to one hundred baths of wine and up to one hundred baths of oil and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.text_gb_plain: 就是银子直到一百他连得，麦子一百柯珥，酒一百罢特，油一百罢特，盐不计其数，也要给他。
verses.text_big5_plain: 就是銀子直到一百他連得，麥子一百柯珥，酒一百罷特，油一百罷特，鹽不計其數，也要給他。

verses.text_gb: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，当为天上神的殿详确办理。为何使忿怒临到王和王众子的国呢？
verses.text_big5: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，當為天上神的殿詳確辦理。為何使忿怒臨到王和王眾子的國呢？
verses.text_en: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven. For why should wrath come upon the kingdom of the king and his sons?
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，当为天上神的殿详确办理。为何使忿怒临到王和王众子的国呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，當為天上神的殿詳確辦理。為何使忿怒臨到王和王眾子的國呢？

verses.text_gb: 我们又要你们知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的、殿役、并在神这殿服事的人，你们不可叫他们进贡、交课、纳税。
verses.text_big5: 我們又要你們知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的、殿役、並在神這殿服事的人，你們不可叫他們進貢、交課、納稅。
verses.text_en: We also inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, taxes, or tolls upon any of the priests and Levites, the singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or servants of this house of God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们又要你们知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的、殿役、并在神这殿服事的人，你们不可叫他们进贡、交课、纳税。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們又要你們知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守門的、殿役、並在神這殿服事的人，你們不可叫他們進貢、交課、納稅。

verses.text_gb: 至于你以斯拉，要照着你[Fn1]神赐你的智[Cra]慧，分派所有明白你神律法的人为士师、审判官，治理河西的众百姓，使他们教训一切不明白神律法的人。
verses.text_big5: 至於你以斯拉，要照著你[Fn1]神賜你的智[Cra]慧，分派所有明白你神律法的人為士師、審判官，治理河西的眾百姓，使他們教訓一切不明白神律法的人。
verses.text_en: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges, who may judge all the people who are in the province beyond the River, all those who know the laws of your God; and teach anyone who does not know them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 至于你以斯拉，要照着你神赐你的智慧，分派所有明白你神律法的人为士师、审判官，治理河西的众百姓，使他们教训一切不明白神律法的人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 至於你以斯拉，要照著你神賜你的智慧，分派所有明白你神律法的人為士師、審判官，治理河西的眾百姓，使他們教訓一切不明白神律法的人。

footnotes.zh: 直译，在你手中你神的智慧。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，在你手中你神的智慧。

refs.text_gb: 全以色列听见王所作的判断，就都敬畏他；因为见他里面有神的智慧，能施行公理。
refs.text_big5: 全以色列聽見王所作的判斷，就都敬畏他；因為見他裏面有神的智慧，能施行公理。
refs.text_en: And all Israel heard of the judgment that the king had exercised, and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of God was within him to execute justice.

verses.text_gb: 凡不遵行你神律法和王律法的人，就当审慎迅速的定他的罪，或治死，或放逐，或抄家，或囚禁。
verses.text_big5: 凡不遵行你神律法和王律法的人，就當審慎迅速的定他的罪，或治死，或放逐，或抄家，或囚禁。
verses.text_en: And everyone who will not observe the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed upon him with all diligence, whether to death or to banishment or to confiscation of goods or to imprisonment.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡不遵行你神律法和王律法的人，就当审慎迅速的定他的罪，或治死，或放逐，或抄家，或囚禁。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡不遵行你神律法和王律法的人，就當審慎迅速的定他的罪，或治死，或放逐，或抄家，或囚禁。

verses.text_gb: 以斯拉说，耶和华我们列祖的神是当受颂赞的，因祂把这样的意思放在王心[Cra]里，要修饰在耶路撒冷耶和华的殿；
verses.text_big5: 以斯拉說，耶和華我們列祖的神是當受頌讚的，因祂把這樣的意思放在王心[Cra]裏，要修飾在耶路撒冷耶和華的殿；
verses.text_en: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this into the king's heart, to beautify the house of Jehovah, which is in Jerusalem,
verses.text_gb_plain: 以斯拉说，耶和华我们列祖的神是当受颂赞的，因祂把这样的意思放在王心里，要修饰在耶路撒冷耶和华的殿；
verses.text_big5_plain: 以斯拉說，耶和華我們列祖的神是當受頌讚的，因祂把這樣的意思放在王心裏，要修飾在耶路撒冷耶和華的殿；

refs.text_gb: 欢欢喜喜地守除酵节七日；因为耶和华使他们欢喜，又使亚述王的心转向他们，坚固他们的手，作以色列神殿的工程。
refs.text_big5: 歡歡喜喜的守除酵節七日；因為耶和華使他們歡喜，又使亞述王的心轉向他們，堅固他們的手，作以色列神殿的工程。
refs.text_en: And held the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy; for Jehovah had made them joyful and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

verses.text_gb: 祂又在王和谋士面前，并王一切大能的军长面前施慈爱与我。因耶[Cra]和华我神的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。
verses.text_big5: 祂又在王和謀士面前，並王一切大能的軍長面前施慈愛與我。因耶[Cra]和華我神的手幫助我，我就得以堅強，從以色列中招聚首領，與我一同上來。
verses.text_en: And has extended lovingkindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the mighty officers of the king. And I was strengthened according to the hand of Jehovah my God upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel leading men to go up with me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂又在王和谋士面前，并王一切大能的军长面前施慈爱与我。因耶和华我神的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂又在王和謀士面前，並王一切大能的軍長面前施慈愛與我。因耶和華我神的手幫助我，我就得以堅強，從以色列中招聚首領，與我一同上來。

refs.text_gb: 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是经学家，精通耶和华以色列神所赐摩西的律法。王赐他一切所求的，是因耶和华他神的手帮助他。
refs.text_big5: 這以斯拉從巴比倫上來，他是經學家，精通耶和華以色列神所賜摩西的律法。王賜他一切所求的，是因耶和華他神的手幫助他。
refs.text_en: This Ezra went up from Babylon, and he was a scribe skilled in the law of Moses, which Jehovah the God of Israel had given; and the king granted him all his request according to the hand of Jehovah his God upon him.

verses.text_gb: 亚达薛西王在位的时候，同我从巴比伦上来的人，他们宗族的首领和他们家谱的记载如下：
verses.text_big5: 亞達薛西王在位的時候，同我從巴比倫上來的人，他們宗族的首領和他們家譜的記載如下：
verses.text_en: Now these are the heads of their fathers' houses and the genealogical enrollment of those who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚达薛西王在位的时候，同我从巴比伦上来的人，他们宗族的首领和他们家谱的记载如下：
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞達薛西王在位的時候，同我從巴比倫上來的人，他們宗族的首領和他們家譜的記載如下：

verses.text_gb: 属非尼哈的子孙有革顺；属以他玛的子孙有但以理；属大卫的子孙有哈突；
verses.text_big5: 屬非尼哈的子孫有革順；屬以他瑪的子孫有但以理；屬大衛的子孫有哈突；
verses.text_en: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.
verses.text_gb_plain: 属非尼哈的子孙有革顺；属以他玛的子孙有但以理；属大卫的子孙有哈突；
verses.text_big5_plain: 屬非尼哈的子孫有革順；屬以他瑪的子孫有但以理；屬大衛的子孫有哈突；

verses.text_gb: 属示迦尼的子孙，属巴录的子孙，有撒迦利亚，同着他按家谱登记的，有男丁一百五十；
verses.text_big5: 屬示迦尼的子孫，屬巴錄的子孫，有撒迦利亞，同著他按家譜登記的，有男丁一百五十；
verses.text_en: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him one hundred fifty males were enrolled by genealogy.
verses.text_gb_plain: 属示迦尼的子孙，属巴录的子孙，有撒迦利亚，同着他按家谱登记的，有男丁一百五十；

verses.text_gb: 属巴哈摩押的子孙有西拉希雅的儿子以利约乃，同着他有男丁二百；
verses.text_big5: 屬巴哈摩押的子孫有西拉希雅的兒子以利約乃，同著他有男丁二百；
verses.text_en: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
verses.text_gb_plain: 属巴哈摩押的子孙有西拉希雅的儿子以利约乃，同着他有男丁二百；
verses.text_big5_plain: 屬巴哈摩押的子孫有西拉希雅的兒子以利約乃，同著他有男丁二百；

verses.text_gb: 属示迦尼的子孙有雅哈悉的儿子，同着他有男丁三百；
verses.text_big5: 屬示迦尼的子孫有雅哈悉的兒子，同著他有男丁三百；
verses.text_en: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
verses.text_gb_plain: 属示迦尼的子孙有雅哈悉的儿子，同着他有男丁三百；
verses.text_big5_plain: 屬示迦尼的子孫有雅哈悉的兒子，同著他有男丁三百；

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

verses.text_big5_plain: 屬以攔的子孫有亞他利雅的兒子耶篩亞，同著他有男丁七十；

verses.text_big5: 屬示法提雅的子孫有米迦勒的兒子西巴第雅，同著他有男丁八十；
verses.text_en: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
verses.text_gb_plain: 属示法提雅的子孙有米迦勒的儿子西巴第雅，同着他有男丁八十；
verses.text_big5_plain: 屬示法提雅的子孫有米迦勒的兒子西巴第雅，同著他有男丁八十；

verses.text_gb: 属约押的子孙有耶歇的儿子俄巴底亚，同着他有男丁二百一十八；
verses.text_big5: 屬約押的子孫有耶歇的兒子俄巴底亞，同著他有男丁二百一十八；
verses.text_en: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

verses.text_gb_plain: 属示罗密的子孙有约细斐的儿子，同着他有男丁一百六十；
verses.text_big5_plain: 屬示羅密的子孫有約細斐的兒子，同著他有男丁一百六十；
